relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Defender Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Scars symbolize glory, but who will remember the soldiers who were cut a bit too deeply?

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Sniper Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Either you learn to control your ignition, or you learn to discern your target. Got it?'

relics.name: Broken Wand - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Caster Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'After watching the 'performances' of certain casters, I decided to quietly put away the Leithanian textbook.'

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Supporter Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Their tactics are always diverse and colorful.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Medic Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: When the day comes that everyone is a doctor capable of curing the disease known as life, we will no longer need doctors.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Specialist Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: If you haven't properly prepared for a live combat drill with a Specialist Operator, you should be prepared for a thorough beating.

relics.name: Fissured Restraints
relics.effect: All enemy units have -7% ATK
relics.flavor: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

relics.name: 'Silent Squad'
relics.effect: All friendly units have +35% ATK, +35% DEF, and +45% HP
relics.flavor: A set of exploration drones remotely controlled by the Rhodes Island Engineering Department. More efficient and safer than ever, they provide operators on field missions the omnidirectional support and defense they need.

relics.name: Abyssal Wyrdmask
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% ATK
relics.flavor: An eldritch mask not belonging to any culture you’re familiar with, capable of making people lose their will to fight... and unconsciously fall into a state of deep contemplation.
relics.unlock: Select 'Leader Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Godmother's Token
relics.effect: All enemy units have -17% ATK
relics.flavor: A laurel of bones, the token of a Sicilian noblewoman. Its orderly appearance symbolizes the desire to stabilize turmoil. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

relics.name: Worn-out Group Photo
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% DEF
relics.flavor: Do you know someone in the photo?

relics.name: Sea Terror Jerky
relics.effect: All enemy units have -21% DEF
relics.flavor: Once their desire to survive overwhelms their terror, the famished Iberians will devour this 'food,' subsequently turning into Sea Terrors on some ordinary day.
relics.unlock: Select 'Gathering Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
relics.effect: All enemy units have -30% DEF
relics.flavor: 'Who will be the judge?'

relics.name: Gold-Plated Die
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP
relics.flavor: The gold-plated die has one side representing life. As for the other nineteen sides...
relics.unlock: Select 'First-Class Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -10% HP
relics.flavor: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

relics.name: 'Profound Silence'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -20% HP
relics.flavor: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

relics.name: Oriron Round Shield
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% DEF
relics.flavor: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.

relics.name: Military Mirror Armor
relics.effect: All friendly units have +25% DEF
relics.flavor: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks on the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.
relics.unlock: Select 'Spearhead Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Old Steam Armor
relics.effect: All friendly units have +35% DEF
relics.flavor: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of the era when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.

relics.name: Emperor's Favor
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.

relics.name: Royal Rapier
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Raging Billows,' when you have exactly 0 Originium Ingots

relics.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.

relics.name: Necklace of the Presence
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.

relics.name: Silver Forks
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it.
relics.unlock: Clear the battle, 'Reality,' without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.

relics.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
relics.effect: All friendly units have +20% HP
relics.flavor: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'

relics.name: First Aid Kit
relics.effect: All friendly units have +35% HP
relics.flavor: '...Use antibiotics and ethanol additives under professional supervision...' —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Unknown Instrument
relics.effect: All friendly units have +50% HP
relics.flavor: Don't ask. It's for your own good.

relics.name: Rusted Razor
relics.effect: All enemies take +15% Physical damage
relics.flavor: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.

relics.name: Carriage Driver's Whip
relics.effect: All enemies take +25% Physical damage
relics.flavor: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'Avenger'
relics.effect: All enemies take +35% Physical damage
relics.flavor: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

relics.name: Standard Anti-Riot Instrument
relics.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage
relics.flavor: Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.

relics.name: Emperor's Collection
relics.effect: All enemies take +30% Arts damage
relics.flavor: The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.
relics.unlock: Select 'Research Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
relics.effect: All enemies take +40% Arts damage
relics.flavor: Their blood yet flows. He should not have left this place.

relics.name: Live Rose
relics.effect: All friendly units receive +20% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: Is it you who nourish her, or is it her who protects you?

relics.name: White Flower Crown
relics.effect: All friendly units receive +30% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving nothing only a pale white color.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recover at least 500000 HP

relics.name: Surging Feast
relics.effect: All friendly units receive +30% healing effectiveness and take -30% Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: We've known how to indulge since birth. Do not resist your desires. Submit to them instead.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 100 Life Point

relics.name: Actor's Perfume
relics.effect: All friendly units recover 1% of their Max HP per second
relics.flavor: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recover at least 250000 HP

relics.name: Designer's Ruler
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% Physical Dodge
relics.flavor: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.

relics.name: 'Arts Killer'
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.

relics.name: Dancer's Bracelets
relics.effect: All friendly units have +10% Physical and Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: The audience breaks into applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers have just been through.
relics.unlock: Clear the 4th Floor, 'Secret Hotbed'

relics.name: Doll House
relics.effect: +10 Starting DP
relics.flavor: All kids need at least one set.

relics.name: Miniature Stage Model
relics.effect: +20 Starting DP
relics.flavor: The red paint has not dried yet. Careful. Don't get that paint on your hand.

relics.name: Dreambind Castle Model
relics.effect: +30 Starting DP
relics.flavor: You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?
relics.unlock: Clear the 2nd Floor, 'Offshore Island'

relics.name: Vortex Confluence
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +30% ATK, and Caster Operators have +3% ATK
relics.flavor: Rule the waves, rule the currents. Once, Ægir and the ocean were synonymous.

relics.name: Ocean Voyage
relics.effect: Caster Operators have +30% ATK, and Specialist Operators have +3% ATK
relics.flavor: Twice they escaped to land, but in this they nevertheless still take pride: Ægir once measured the ocean.

relics.name: Jet-Black Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Melee Operators on High Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Columbian dancer's steps are firm and strong, her taps reverberating loudly in the air as she strikes the ground.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Raging Billows' 3 times, when you have recruited not less than 6 Ranged Operators or 6 Melee Operators

relics.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor, 'Raging Billows' 3 times, when you have recruited not less than 6 Ranged Operators or 6 Melee Operators

relics.name: Viviparous Lily
relics.effect: When a battle begins, reduces the DP Cost of all Operators by 3, then scrambles their DP Cost
relics.flavor: An organism that defies common sense. A plant-like ability to reproduce, an animal-like desire to.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: Chitinous Ripper
relics.effect: When a battle begins, a random Operator will have +100% ATK and +100% HP for that battle
relics.flavor: A more efficient way of growing an exoskeleton. It can tear prey apart, resist impact, and also be turned into a delicacy for its kin.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: Ancient Gaulish Silver Coin
relics.effect: All Operators start with +6 SP
relics.flavor: A coin once circulated in the now fallen nation 'Gaul.' It is in very good shape, making it highly valuable as a collector's item.

relics.name: Bank of Gaul Check
relics.effect: All Operators start with +12 SP
relics.flavor: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

relics.name: 'Second Economic Reform Act'
relics.effect: All Operators start with +18 SP
relics.flavor: With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.

relics.name: Vanilla Soda
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s
relics.flavor: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.

relics.name: Fowlbeast Liver Pate
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.35/s
relics.flavor: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Dreaming Essence
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s
relics.flavor: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.

relics.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 3s
relics.flavor: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria’s bustling cities, it is now discontinued.

relics.name: Water of Life
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 2.5s
relics.flavor: The strongest Ursus liquors go straight to one’s head, but it's said that the healthy Ursus adult can down several bottles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Royal Liqueur
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 1.5s
relics.flavor: The fine wines of the fallen nation of Gaul have now become prized treasures for collectors. The place of production has moved to Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.

relics.name: 'Unleashings'
relics.effect: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
relics.unlock: Clear the battle, 'Separation and Unity,' without losing any Life Point

relics.name: String Puppet
relics.effect: Enemies receive 700 Arts Damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?

relics.name: 'Children's Puppet'
relics.effect: Enemies receive 1000 Arts Damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.

relics.name: Victory Horn
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 100%
relics.flavor: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!

relics.name: Flash Camera
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 110%
relics.flavor: Every photo shot by this camera is washed out in white, with only the victim's twisted expression faintly visible.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

relics.name: Therapy Tape
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%
relics.flavor: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.

relics.name: Royal Brooch
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15 RES, and dodge one instance of damage after deployment
relics.flavor: An ornament worn by Gaulish royalty, made from gold and inlaid with expensive Originium crystals. They are more than decoration: many of these brooches hide Originium circuits loaded with defensive Arts.

relics.name: Old Fan
relics.effect: All Operators gain +10% ATK for every different type of Operator class in the squad
relics.flavor: When it rains for several days on end, the old Yanese Tianshi complains to his friends about the pain in his knees, before casually waving his fan and driving away the rainclouds. It is about time he taught this trick to his young apprentice, currently working at the Central Judicial Office.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 15 Operators

relics.name: Nachzehrer's Cane
relics.effect: When a friendly unit is overhealed, nearby enemies take Arts damage equal to the overheal amount
relics.flavor: Life is the Nachzehrer's sustenance and currency.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Medic Operators

relics.name: Angelina's Inspiration
relics.effect: All enemies have -15% Movement Speed, and -1 Weight Level
relics.flavor: The girl has no qualms about sharing her Originium Arts. She believes that you will use them for the right reasons.

relics.name: Scout's Scope
relics.effect: Enemies take increased damage from friendly units as range increases (max 100%)
relics.flavor: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.

relics.name: Black Tulip
relics.effect: Friendly Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60 seconds; this bonus will be reset when a skill ends
relics.flavor: The Silence crushed the Iberians, so she wishes to speak up. If her words are not sharp enough, then her sword will speak for her.

relics.name: Assault Co-op - Sharp Blade
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Vanguard and Guard Operators by +8% for each Vanguard or Guard Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Use the sharpest spear to strike the hardest shield. I guarantee you that the shield will break first, trust me.

relics.name: Fortification Co-op - Phalanx
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Defender and Supporter Operators by +8% for each Defender or Supporter Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Like a huge ship running over rubble.

relics.name: Ranged Co-op - Remote Strike
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Medic and Sniper Operators by +8% for each Medic or Sniper Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: If you can solve the problem from a reasonable distance, why do you have to literally butt heads?

relics.name: Sabotage Co-op - Suppression
relics.effect: Increases the ASPD of Caster and Specialist Operators by +6 for each Caster or Specialist Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Don’t worry about accuracy. Take enough shots, and you’re guaranteed to land something!

relics.name: Spinach Pack
relics.effect: All friendly units have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.

relics.name: Wrath of Siracusans
relics.effect: All friendly units have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce, a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver, earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.

relics.name: Ribbon of Honor
relics.effect: All friendly units have +100% ATK when blocking only one enemy
relics.flavor: Numerous actors have played this character, yet none of them were able to save the character's dearest friend.

relics.name: Royal Alliance Treaty
relics.effect: All Operators no longer receive any damage from Sarkaz enemies
relics.flavor: The old Sarkaz courts sacrificed themselves to obtain their power. Ever since, the courts have come to terms with one another, banding together against their common enemy.

relics.name: King's New Lance
relics.effect: When Life Point is 1, all friendly units have +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.

relics.name: Castle's Offspring
relics.effect: All Operators gain +300 DEF and +30 RES after being deployed for 100 seconds
relics.flavor: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

relics.name: Distant Home's Guide
relics.effect: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; friendly units deployed on that tile will recover 1 SP and 3% Max HP per second
relics.flavor: This ancient ring is actually said to be a special navigation device, used to find emergency supplies that the Ægir once secretly stashed in various spots across the ocean. Follow the ocean's currents, be guided by wind; your homeland will always continue to bestow gifts upon you.

relics.name: Abandoned Banner
relics.effect: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; friendly units deployed on that tile have +50% ATK and +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: There is nothing special about this dismasted flag, but the Abyssal Hunters can use it to find combat supplies that the Ægir once secretly stashed in various spots across the ocean. They have no way of knowing what the ocean has forgiven, but there is no need for them to forgive. The fight never ends.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 120 Operators deployed in battle

relics.name: Medicine Sticks
relics.effect: All friendly units gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed
relics.flavor: In ancient times, whenever Great Yan's armies fought, they would march forward carrying these. Mulberry drew inspiration from this and made an edible plaster, excellent for working out the masseter muscle and revitalizing one's spirit.

relics.name: Fincatcher's Shawl
relics.effect: Ranged Operators gain Camouflage
relics.flavor: A shawl often worn by Iberian seamen when they went to hunt giant fins in the shallows, the unique texture and color making them blend in with the reef. The Rhodes Island Engineering Department designed a combat uniform with an optical camouflage effect based on this prototype, which is currently in the testing stage.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Saint Iberia' once

relics.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
relics.effect: Operators gain +70% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.

relics.name: 'The Return'
relics.effect: Operators gain +130% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

relics.name: Convalescence Experience Card
relics.effect: All Operators gain +40 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: A special service from the Convalescent Garden! Each Operator is entitled to one physiotherapy session from the Convalescent Garden before each of their field operations. Non-transferrable.

relics.name: Convalescence Prime Membership
relics.effect: All Operators gain +70 ASPD for 10 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: A special service collaboratively provided by the Convalescent Garden and the Medical Department! Each Operator is entitled to one comprehensive physical and psychological assessment, as well as a physiotherapy session. Afterwards, they can also taste Podenco's homemade flower cakes.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Tidelinked Immortal' once

relics.name: Old George Nutritional Paste
relics.effect: Operators have increased ATK proportional to how high their HP is, up to a maximum of +30% ATK at 100% HP
relics.flavor: This poor-tasting fortified nutritional supplement was originally a 'dietary supplement' periodically provided to Columbian Pioneers, but after extensive marketing, it suddenly became a 'beauty product' beloved by nobles.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat a total of 500 'Baleful Broodlings'

relics.name: Emergency Active Agent
relics.effect: Operators have increased ASPD proportional to how low their HP is, up to a maximum of +60 ASPD at 30% HP
relics.flavor: An injection commonly used in Rim Billiton's local mines. Its strong active ingredient can stimulate the workers' senses and ensure their work efficiency in extreme environments. Life and engineering both have deadlines, and for them, this is simply a multiple-choice question.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, allow 15 [Skimming Sea Drifters] to enter the Objective Point

relics.name: King's Buckler
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators have +2 Block
relics.flavor: Keep your eyes straight ahead, and let your stalwart heart resist all hardship.

relics.name: King's Staff
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP every 2 seconds
relics.flavor: Let go of worthless pomp and treat others with kindness. They will no doubt return in kind.

relics.name: King's Crown
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all friendly units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles
relics.flavor: O Nameless King, may you continue to bless Iberia, even should your kingdom fall to ruin.

relics.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
relics.effect: Summons will no longer use Deployment slots
relics.flavor: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Lingering Pathshaper' once

relics.name: Derivative Terminal - Supercharged Mod
relics.effect: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: A product of Raythean Industries. The latest remote-control operation terminal, capable of connecting to the signals of most existing remotely-operated units on its own, complete with customization options and performance upgrades. Not yet available on the market.

relics.name: Uncle Vought Total Care Kit
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units take 40% less Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: A complete care kit produced by the Columbian old salon product manufacturer, 'Uncle Vought.' Provence has modeled for this product. 'Take good care of your tail and your ears - after all, they're your second face.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, allow 5 [Skimming Sea Drifters] to enter the Objective Point

relics.name: Ursus Felt Rug
relics.effect: All friendly melee units take 40% less Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: The people of Ursus will spread this special felt rug across their cellars when storing grains for the winter, in order to absorb water and prevent moisture. When the cellar becomes a hiding place, it also helps shelter the occupants from the wind and snow for a while.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat a total of 200 'Baleful Broodlings'

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators start with +15 SP
relics.flavor: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Tidelinked Bishop' once

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills is decreased by -35%
relics.flavor: As an operator who often enters the battlefield before anyone else, you cannot fathom what they have been through.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Tidelinked Bishop' 3 times

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have +50% ATK and DEF
relics.flavor: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Tidelinked Bishop' 6 times

relics.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The warrior walks onto the battlefield. The warrior unsheathes his blade. The warrior faces his foe.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
relics.effect: Guard Operators have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: 'This is the 7th blade you’ve broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

relics.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
relics.effect: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack
relics.flavor: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Pathshaper' once

relics.name: Bend Spears - Army of One
relics.effect: Guard Operators have +1 Block
relics.flavor: One does not need to don heavy armor or hold up a shield to resist enemy attacks. Oftentimes, the best defense is to quickly eliminate those that would harm you.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Pathshaper' 3 times

relics.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Pathshaper' 6 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
relics.effect: Defender Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
relics.effect: Defender Operators have +60% ATK
relics.flavor: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Saint Carmen' once

relics.name: Iron Guard - Advance
relics.effect: Defender Operators have -1 Block (will not be reduced below 1 on deployment), but gain +40% ATK and +40 ASPD
relics.flavor: In exchange for an opportunity to attack, the shattered ranks made one more advance.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Saint Carmen' 3 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
relics.effect: Defender Operators restore 2 SP after being attacked
relics.flavor: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader 'Saint Carmen' 6 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Moving Fortress
relics.effect: Defender Operators have +100% ATK, +100% DEF, and +1 Block for 15 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: Nobody can break through their defenses, and even fewer are able to escape from their assault. If every combatant has a mission, then that mission is to change the situation on the battlefield the moment they enter the fray.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Defender Operators

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +20% ATK
relics.flavor: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Homecoming' event 2 times

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -40% HP, but gain +40% ATK
relics.flavor: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Homecoming' event 4 times

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +70 ASPD
relics.flavor: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria can almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Homecoming' event 6 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving
relics.effect: Caster Operators have +25% ATK and +25 ASPD
relics.flavor: When Leithanians gazes up at the great spires, they often see some strange or even celestial phenomena.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Like Flames to Wood' event 2 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s
relics.flavor: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Like Flames to Wood' event 4 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -40% HP, but deal +70% Arts damage
relics.flavor: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Like Flames to Wood' event 6 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
relics.effect: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators’ skills is decreased by -40%
relics.flavor: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Lighthouse Keeper' event 2 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
relics.effect: Friendly units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +20% ATK
relics.flavor: Bringing meals, showing the right route to take, or even having a heart-to-heart. The key difference between victory and defeat often lies in these little things.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Lighthouse Keeper' event 6 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
relics.effect: Enemies within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -20% DEF and -20% RES
relics.flavor: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Lighthouse Keeper' event 4 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
relics.effect: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s
relics.flavor: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Camp' event 2 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
relics.effect: Medic Operators have +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Compared to the feat of snatching a life from the grip of death, what is three days of coma afterwards?
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Camp' event 4 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
relics.effect: Friendly units within the attack range of Medic Operators gain Status Resistance
relics.flavor: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Camp' event 6 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: There may be many means, but only one end.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: An endless amount of rust to scrape off, and endless amount of work.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Advance Squad' event 2 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Isolation
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +40% ATK and DEF
relics.flavor: The director of S.W.E.E.P. does not have any mission participation records. *None*.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
relics.effect: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators is reduced by -35%
relics.flavor: Sound is eliminated the moment the shadows pass by, and whoever hears them is next.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Advance Squad' event 4 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Overwhelm
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +2 shift strength
relics.flavor: Terrain is one aspect of battle... That’s all I can say.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the 'Advance Squad' event 6 times

relics.name: Hand of Spikes
relics.effect: Protector, Arts Protector, and Duelist Operators deal 100% DEF as Arts damage per second to all enemies they are blocking
relics.flavor: Let the enemy make his move. He will be his own downfall.

relics.name: Hand of Choker
relics.effect: Heavyshooter, Deadeye, and Besieger Operators' attacks will instantly defeat enemies below 20% HP
relics.flavor: With your last strength, break open a last bit of hope for yourself.

relics.name: Hand of Buckler
relics.effect: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal additional Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP
relics.flavor: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.

relics.name: Hand of Diffusion
relics.effect: Fortress, Chain Caster, and Blast Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit
relics.flavor: Strength in numbers.

relics.name: Hand of Superspeed
relics.effect: Executor, Ambusher, and Dollkeeper Operators gain +120 ASPD when there are no friendly units in the four adjacent tiles
relics.flavor: You swing your hand, leaving not even an afterimage.

relics.name: Hand of Snatcher
relics.effect: Charger, Pioneer, and Tactician Operators have -12 DP Cost and generate an additional 6 DP after defeating an enemy
relics.flavor: Whatever it is you do not have, snatch it away from your enemy. There is no need to hesitate.

relics.name: Hand of Purification
relics.effect: Bard, Phalanx Caster, and Therapist Operators deal 50% ATK as Arts damage to all enemies in their attack range
relics.flavor: Where it is, dust is not.

relics.name: Hand of Pulverization
relics.effect: Artilleryman, Splash Caster, and Flinger Operators gain +15% ATK for every time they deal damage to the same unit, up to 150%; this bonus will reset if no damage is dealt for 5 seconds
relics.flavor: Your goal isn't just to hit the bullseye over and over.

relics.name: Hand of Flowing Water
relics.effect: Increases the SP recovery rate of Core Caster, Mystic Caster, and Summoner Operators by +0.5/s whenever they use a skill, up to 4 stacks
relics.flavor: The ocean's flow never ceases, because it is always surging.

relics.name: Game Room Admin Access Card
relics.effect: Immediately Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the Operators... and remember to lock the door every day.

relics.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: You have the lady's permission!
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 15 Operators

relics.name: Antique Casting
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Heavenly forge, take the bounty of the earth.' ...Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 35 Operators

relics.name: Topographical Map
relics.effect: +1 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +4% DEF
relics.flavor: A hand-drawn map that exudes a sense of antiquity. The labels and corresponding terrain have been enlarged, and there seems to be something off about its scale.

relics.name: Conch of Divine Whispers
relics.effect: +1 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +4% HP
relics.flavor: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.

relics.name: Night-Whispers in the Forest
relics.effect: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% DEF
relics.flavor: A special aromatherapy set prepared for field operators by the Convalescent Garden, consisting of fifteen herbal extracts in 172 different combinations. When the wind wends into wooded vales, all creatures lower their voices, and one can find respite.

relics.name: Church Alms Meal Voucher
relics.effect: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% HP
relics.flavor: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.

relics.name: Regional Action Plan
relics.effect: 4-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: Rhodes Island has dedicated offices in every major hub. The Messengers are doing what they can to weave a fragile web across the world.
relics.unlock: Clear the 1st Floor, 'Sunshine Coast'

relics.name: Comprehensive Operation File
relics.effect: 5-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: A vessel sailing upon the land is like treading upon thin ice. Remember to always expand your worldview.
relics.unlock: At any time, have five 5-star Operators

relics.name: Secret HR Letter
relics.effect: 6-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: '■■■ gave it to you? Never mind, then.'
relics.unlock: At any time, have four 6-star Operators

relics.name: Draft of a Speech
relics.effect: All Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: She was a little nervous, a little worried, but still remained resolute. When the microphone turned on, her long ears quivered slightly.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 15 Operators

relics.name: Rusted Iron Hammer
relics.effect: Shop vendors charge -50% Originium Ingots for their goods
relics.flavor: 'Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.'

relics.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle
relics.flavor: Hang in there, help's on the way.

relics.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle
relics.flavor: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 150 collectibles

relics.name: Acahuallan Bowl
relics.effect: Restore 4 Life Point, +2 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.

relics.name: Three-Dimensional Art Display
relics.effect: Restore 7 Life Point, restore an additional 1 Life Point after each battle
relics.flavor: The impression that Rhine Lab often gives is akin to this work of art: inscrutable, multi-faceted, impossible to sift fact from fiction.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 100 Life Point

relics.name: 'Multipurpose' Hair Clip
relics.effect: +1 Key, +1 Die Roll, +1 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: Its materials are clearly damage-resistant, but are its other functions as impressive as what the Kazimierzian merchant boasted? Come to think of it, why does a bobby pin need so many extra features anyway?
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes

relics.name: Three-Key Contract
relics.effect: +3 Keys
relics.flavor: According to regulations, lighthouse keepers must always carry three keys: one to unlock the main door, another to establish communication, and one to activate the searchlight. Sign your name, and the contract is set in stone. Carry the keys with you at all times, regardless of life or death.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 100 non-combat nodes

relics.name: Portable Scriptures
relics.effect: +2 Die Rolls
relics.flavor: The few Iberian faithfuls who can still read often carry around a pocket-sized version of the Scriptures with them, taking it out to glance over a few lines during the brief lulls in their struggles for survival. It offers but a modicum of peace.

relics.name: Inquisitor's Scripture Cloth
relics.effect: Gain +1 Die Roll after each battle
relics.flavor: As part of the decorations adorning an Inquisitor's clothing, this ribbon is inlaid with the Scriptures. Their hearts are firm and unwavering, and these accessories reinforce that image.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 50 battles

relics.name: Deep-Sea Sire Sculpture
relics.effect: +6 Die Rolls
relics.flavor: The Church of the Deep cultists believe that gods sleep in the depths of the ocean, and the teeming Sea Terrors seem to confirm their beliefs. Seeing as that is indeed the truth, they no longer have any reason to hesitate.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 100 battles

relics.name: Duck Lord's Golden Brick
relics.effect: Upgrades your die
relics.flavor:
'How can someone completely rid themselves of misfortune?' 
'You have a gold brick in your hand, don't you? Shove it up misfortune's mouth.'
relics.unlock: Unlock 'Divine Duckforce' in Cognitive Shaping

relics.name: Defender-2
relics.effect: +5 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: A mass-produced defensive-type drone. It doesn't make sense how it only seems to be useful in the hands of the enemy.

relics.name: Embedded Armor Plate
relics.effect: -2 Max Life Point, +8 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: 'You don't understand a thing, test subject. Compared to what those monsters of Ursus suffered, a measly plate of armor embedded into your body isn't even worth mentioning.'
relics.unlock: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Point (including mission failures)

relics.name: Dario's Lantern
relics.effect: When obtained, suppresses a designated Operator's Rejection
relics.flavor: A lantern once wielded by Inquisitor Dario. Even after his death, the flames of his conviction still burn brightly upon this land.

relics.name: 'King's Fellowship'
relics.effect: +2 Objective Shield, coverts all Life Point into an equivalent amount of Objective Shield (Cannot be reduced below 1 by this effect)
relics.flavor: The Cultists of the Deep did not achieve success overnight; they lingered at the junction between land and sea for ages, preparing for the calamity that would come to be known as the Profound Silence.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: Tulip's Secret Formula
relics.effect: When obtained, suppresses a designated Operator's Rejection
relics.flavor: An emergency topical ointment produced through empirical analysis and numerous clinical trials, capable of effectively inhibiting the adverse side-effects Seaborn cells cause within the human body.

relics.name: Paraffin and Balsam
relics.effect: -30 Light, when obtained, suppresses a designated Operator's Rejection
relics.flavor: Burn it and your impurities shall be shunned, allowing you to remain a pure human being. Praise the flame.

relics.name: Nightsun Grass
relics.effect: +5 Light
relics.flavor: Only a faint glimmer of light remains on the leaves of the nightsun flower. Contains certain detoxifying compounds and can be used as medicine.

relics.name: Cathedral Puzzle
relics.effect: When obtained, randomly gain 1 Revelation
relics.flavor: Every time a piece of the puzzle falls, the Iberian Cathedral becomes more complete. In these times of decay, there is ample comfort to be found in simply being able to piece together one of history's most glorious wonders.

relics.name: Coin-Operated Toy
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +3 ASPD
relics.flavor: No idea why anyone would like a design like this, but its overall concept is indeed praiseworthy—Just insert a coin, and even a statue will start moving. There is nothing truer in this world.

relics.name: Chivalric Commandments - New Edition
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +5 ASPD
relics.flavor: Taking solemn vows is a thing of the past. The spirit of modern knighthood requires more flexible displays. Go ahead and input your number in the communications device, and you too will be an honorary knight.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 40 Originium Ingots remaining

relics.name: Portrait of Breogan
relics.effect: All Operators lose 15 SP when deployed
relics.flavor: The subject of the portrait is an Ægir who used to be well-known in Iberia. His inventions and feats once made the country shine, but when the tide drowned out the golden light, his fate was sealed.

relics.name: Leviathan's Anabolism
relics.effect: All enemies gain +25% HP
relics.flavor: Slowly did He fall into the deepest depths of the ocean. His blood, flesh, skin, and bones separated and dissolved—they were swept up by the sea's currents, absorbed by all life, and became sustenance for the propagation of the entire ocean.

relics.name: Failed Specimen
relics.effect: When obtained, immediately afflicts a random Operator with a Rejection
relics.flavor: An incomplete shelled specimen. Debris falls from small crevices, sticks together, accumulates, and merges with the dead plants inside, until the original husk is completely swallowed up.

relics.name: 'Emergency Light'
relics.effect: Lose an additional 2 Light after each battle
relics.flavor: Ægir warriors used to lock some kind of small luminescent Sea Terror inside a transparent contraption to serve as lighting during emergency situations. The restless Sea Terror would smash into its confines, releasing even more light in a frenzy until it died, staining its prison with an indescribable black glue.

relics.name: 'Luminous Corpse'
relics.effect: Lose an additional 3 Light after each battle
relics.flavor: To provide light to we many during long migrations, the weakest organs among the collective would dissolve on their own and start glowing, leaving nothing behind but a transparent membrane.

relics.name: Bishop's Research
relics.effect: Lose an additional 5 Light after each battle
relics.flavor: Almost all of the bishop's lifelong research can be found among these documents and notes, many of which involve experiments that transcended ethics and morality. In his eyes, making contact with the Seaborn was just a means to an end for his ultimate vision: allowing human beings to evolve into a more powerful existence through fusion with the Seaborn.

relics.name: Caerula Animus
relics.effect: -50 Light; when obtained, immediately afflicts a random Operator with a Rejection, and leads the exploration toward a different ending
relics.flavor: The surviving core organ of the 'Firstborn' that devoured Its birthplace and soon died afterwards. Only the Seaborn are able to assimilate it, but only humans are able to understand the grief contained within. Alas, even for those whose evolution never ends, their - Their - suffering will always persist.

relics.name: Breath of the Tide
relics.effect: +1 Deployment Limit; when obtained, [Tide-Hunt Knight] will appear on the battlefield until defeated
relics.flavor: He appeared near you because he smelled the scent of the tides. You mean nothing to him.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: Regressed Rocinante
relics.effect: [Tide-Hunt Knight] will no longer appear on the battlefield
relics.flavor: Only a hero can ride it. When the hero dies, so too does its life end.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: 'Absurd Fate'
relics.effect: +10 Originium Ingots, +1 Key
relics.flavor: His name is widely known in Kazimierz, and his descendants set up companies to benefit from his renown. All the things he defended with his life have become nothing more than gold coins in a wallet.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: The Knight's Corpus
relics.effect: [Tide-Hunt Knight] has -80% DEF
relics.flavor: Resisting does not come without a price. The knight's body had long since become riddled with wounds, but he paid no heed. He will fight until the bitter end, even should his body be smashed to pieces.
relics.unlock: Complete the ending of an adventure

relics.name: 'Last Refrain'
relics.effect: When obtained, randomly gain 2 Revelations
relics.flavor:
Cry, cry, for where are the Abyssal Hunters now? 
Alas, alas, there is nothing in the ocean but the sound of the tide.

relics.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
relics.effect: All enemies take +150% True damage
relics.flavor: A small, black crown.

relics.name: 'End of Times'
relics.effect: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
relics.flavor: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, spend a total of 100 Originium Ingots at shops

relics.name: 'Flames of the Inquisition'
relics.effect: Operators recover 2 SP when dealing damage to [Sea Monsters]
relics.flavor: Because the evil creatures were born from the sea, they were afraid. Afraid of the flames that would never mix with the sea.
relics.unlock: In the 'Prospective Investment System,' reach an Investment Reserve Balance of 325

relics.name: 'Painful Happiness'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP and Movement Speed
relics.flavor: Oripathy is spreading among the troupe members. Some collapsed, some broke out crying, some were overjoyed, and some turned their attention to writing. It was at such a time that the young man received his coming-of-age present. He will sing his very last song as an actor.

relics.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
relics.effect: Deals Stun on all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Protection Objective
relics.flavor: The illumination device produced after reverse engineering the Eye of Iberia. It is powerful enough to penetrate layers of dark clouds, as well as temporarily repel powerful enemies.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Point

relics.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
relics.effect: Deals 3000 True Damage on all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Protection Objective
relics.flavor: 'It has pierced Victoria's heart, and is watching the empire bleed.'

relics.name: 'Glory Pack'
relics.effect: When an Operator is defeated, it will Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for 6 seconds
relics.flavor: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the duration of the knight competition season. Choose from a variety of complementary betting packages to minimize your losses on any particular match.
relics.unlock: Select 'Support Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'Sui's Wrath'
relics.effect: Whenever you deploy a unit, deal 3000 Arts damage to a random enemy and the area around it
relics.flavor: The Feranmut lifts its head, heaven and earth cower in fear.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 3 Specialist Operators

relics.name: 'Bedrock'
relics.effect: All Operators have +5 DP Cost, but gain +15% ATK, DEF, and HP
relics.flavor: A weapon said to have been made specifically for an Abyssal Hunter. His master once fought alongside Skadi, smashing the tentacles of a benthic behemoth. But when he cast aside his weapon to block a bony projectile for Skadi, he vanished into the midst of the Sea Terrors' swarm.

relics.name: 'Wavebreaker'
relics.effect: All Operators have -25% HP, but have -50% Redeployment Time
relics.flavor: A weapon said to have been made specifically for an Abyssal Hunter. Her master once was one of Gladiia's team members, responsible for culling countless Sea Terrors. But in order to allow the other teams to approach the benthic behemoth, she voluntarily stayed behind after being seriously wounded, and nobody ever saw her again.

relics.name: 'Pulse of the Ocean'
relics.effect: All friendly units have +10 ASPD, all enemy units have -10 ASPD
relics.flavor: An exquisite water flow meter, capable of monitoring the flow of ocean currents in real time. A common sight among the Ægir people's underwater transportation tools.

relics.name: 'Determination'
relics.effect: All Operators gain Block +2, DEF and HP +120%, and RES +20; leads the exploration towards a different conclusion
relics.flavor: Mizuki's humanity has not faded. He has accepted the Seaborn as a human, and he can transform back from a Seaborn to a human.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'Vigil'
relics.effect: All Operators gain Block +1; leads the exploration towards a different conclusion
relics.flavor: Mizuki does not particularly identify with either humans or Seaborn. He only does what he thinks is right.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'Hesitation'
relics.effect: All Operators gain Block -1 (will not go below 1); leads the exploration towards a different conclusion
relics.flavor: The manifestation of Mizuki's self-doubt, as his Seaborn instincts overcome his humanity. It will continue to have a negative impact, as long as his self-identity remains unclear.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'Endless Life'
relics.effect: Afflicts a random Operator with a Rejection at the start of each new floor
relics.flavor: Sac-like tissues found in Sea Terrors, used to store eggs prior to laying them. They detach from the host after death, maintaining activity for a period of time. Be careful not to break them!

relics.name: Caerula Memory
relics.effect: Light -100, immediately afflicts a random Operator with a Rejection
relics.flavor: Even vague memories of the lab's research are enough to induce fear. Perhaps you and people like you have all done something unforgivable for the sake of survival.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Caerula Arbor
relics.effect: Enemy ASPD +15; at the end of operation, if no Life Point is lost, gain +15 Light
relics.flavor: Through His body, Mizuki becomes one of Them. His consciousness is long gone, but His cells live on. The magma is His food, and the great tree grows towards the core of the planet. If left unchecked, He will become reborn in the planet's core, and invite Terra into we many.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: HR Bronze Seal
relics.effect: Recruit a random 5-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
relics.flavor: Emblem assigned to specific Operators when ■■■ receives an emergency deployment command. Your receipt of it signifies that ■■■ has completed the assignment.

relics.name: Doctor Silver Seal
relics.effect: Recruit a random 6-star Operator that is automatically Promoted
relics.flavor: Emblem that you instructed to be sent out at the right time before you left. Your selected Operator has joined the field mission at the camp, while handing it back to you the way you left it.

relics.name: Wordless Coral
relics.effect: Recover 5 Light for every die roll
relics.flavor: There is no writing on it, only a faint scent. Chemicals are transmitted through the air, communicating information to we many.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Op [Looking Forward, Looking Back] without losing any Life Points

relics.name: Underground Scorch
relics.effect: At the end of operation, if no Life Point is lost, gain +6 Light
relics.flavor: The people of the sea are unconcerned with what happens on land, and thus will never understand the warmth of the sun which reaches into the soul.

relics.name: Great Machinations
relics.effect: At the end of operation, if no Life Point is lost, gain +9 Light
relics.flavor: 'Do not envy the sun on the surface. We can do better.'
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Op [Guns and Order] without losing any Life Points

relics.name: Solidified Lamp Oil
relics.effect: Light loss from battle damage reduced by 40%
relics.flavor: Solidified oil that can be added to a lamp to keep it burning bright.

relics.name: Sanctified Lamp Oil
relics.effect: Light loss from battle damage reduced by 60%
relics.flavor: Processed lamp oil that the Inquisition issues to its Inquisitors. The scent sharpens the mind, keeping them alert and aware of every evil.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Op [Ember Phalanx] without losing any Life Points

relics.name: 'King's Crystal'
relics.effect: At the end of battle, -2 Life Points (will not go lower than 1), +1 Hope, +5 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: The Iberians' contact with the Seaborn goes back further than they can imagine, but they did not know what the Seaborn were back then.

relics.name: Hand of Branding
relics.effect: Whenever a [Dreadnought], [Duelist], or [Soloblade] defeats an enemy, all Operators of these classes gain 1% ATK, 1 ASPD and 1% max HP permanently (max 99)
relics.flavor: Victory is the best supply.

relics.name: Wrankwood Safety Suit
relics.effect: For each Cursed Curio you have, all allied units gain DEF +25%, RES +10
relics.flavor: Used at Wrankwood studios for high-difficulty shoots. Inspired by military gear. FEater once refused to wear it while shooting a collaborative project.

relics.name: 'Flashing Swords'
relics.effect: For each Cursed Curio you have, all allied units gain ASPD +35
relics.flavor: Limited-edition montage from Wrankwood, showing the making-of and behind-the-scenes footage of classic action movies.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Op [Hunger and Thirst] without losing any Life Points

relics.name: Mercenary Insurance
relics.effect: All friendly units gain 10% Sanctuary, increased to 35% if Light is below 50.
relics.flavor: Special insurance offered to independent mercenaries, indemnifying against mission failure or excessive loss.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Learning
relics.effect: For every collectible owned, [Caster] ATK +2%, ASPD +1
relics.flavor: When you have taken in the wisdom of all the land, ignorance becomes the enemy's weakness.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Light of Wisdom
relics.effect: For every collectible owned, [Caster] ATK +3%, ASPD +2
relics.flavor: Knowledge and experience should not remain untapped. They should be the key to victory.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Solving
relics.effect: For every [Caster] Operator on the field, enemy RES -12
relics.flavor: A caster's greatest enemy is another caster.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Op [Mutual Aid] without losing any Life Points

relics.name: Iron Guard - Wall
relics.effect: [Defender] Operators gain DEF +40%, RES +10
relics.flavor: No one is stupid enough to ram a wall with their body, right?

relics.name: Iron Guard - Tower
relics.effect: [Defender] Operators gain DEF +70%, RES +20, Elemental Injury taken -60%
relics.flavor: It rises into the clouds, looking down at the enemies jumping up and down by its feet.

relics.name: Survivor Contract
relics.effect: At the start of battle, a random Operator gains +20% ATK and DEF, plus an additional +20% at the end of each battle
relics.flavor: A very long contract, in which every term and condition is the result of experience, leaving no room for chance or sentiment. Satisfy them all to be the final survivor.
relics.unlock: Unlock [Matter from Mind] in Cognitive Shaping

relics.name: Fosterer Genotype
relics.effect: An Operator with Rejection will assimilate 2 nearby normal Operators. When assimilation is complete, the Operator with Rejection temporarily gains [Evolution]: Rejection has no effect, gains 35% Sanctuary, attacks ignore 35% RES and DEF
relics.flavor: Collective evolution is driven by individual mutation. Individual problems are solved by collective intelligence. Lu is highly confident in this model. If the Fosterer Project has enough time, perhaps...

relics.name: Topographical Map
relics.effect: +1 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +4% DEF
relics.flavor: A hand-drawn map that exudes a sense of antiquity. The labels and corresponding terrain have been enlarged, and there seems to be something off about its scale.

relics.name: Conch of Divine Whispers
relics.effect: +1 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +4% HP
relics.flavor: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.

relics.name: Night-Whispers in the Forest
relics.effect: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% DEF
relics.flavor: A special aromatherapy set prepared for field operators by the Convalescent Garden, consisting of fifteen herbal extracts in 172 different combinations. When the wind wends into wooded vales, all creatures lower their voices, and one can find respite.

relics.name: Church Alms Meal Voucher
relics.effect: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% HP
relics.flavor: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.

relics.name: Red Bow Tie
relics.effect: Hope +2, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.

relics.name: Solo Music Box
relics.effect: Hope +4, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.

relics.name: Pried Open Toolbox
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: The tool box of the troupe's prop master. From nails to dummy props, it has everything.

relics.name: Antiquated Sheet Music
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.

relics.name: Letter of Termination Contract
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: You can break free from this troupe with just one signature.

relics.name: Universal Key
relics.effect: Hope +6
relics.flavor: An old, silver key. It can open any door. As the keeper, the troupe's butler naturally needs a key that unlocks all the secrets here.

relics.name: Antique Coins
relics.effect: Immediately gain 10 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: An ancient, rusty coin, weathered to the point that one can no longer identify its age. Things like these are all too common throughout Terra's barrens.

relics.name: Actor's Jewelry Box
relics.effect: Immediately gain 18 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: A box containing all kinds of shattered jewelry. The young lead actor wore this jewelry and stepped onto the stage, in the end falling from its highest point.

relics.name: Game Room Admin Access Card
relics.effect: Immediately Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the operators... and remember to lock the door every day.

relics.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: You have the lady's permission!

relics.name: Regional Action Plan
relics.effect: 4-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: Rhodes Island has established dedicated offices in every important hub area. The Messengers are doing what they can to weave a fragile web across this land.

relics.name: Comprehensive Operation File
relics.effect: 5-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: A vessel sailing upon the land, like treading upon thin ice. Remember to always expand your overall view.

relics.name: Secret HR Letter
relics.effect: 6-star Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: '■■■ gave this to you? Guess there's no problem then.'

relics.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle
relics.flavor: Hang in there, help's on the way.

relics.name: Featured Canned Meat
relics.effect: +1 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units recover 3 HP per second
relics.flavor: For travelers on a long journey, the convenience of 'Ready to Eat' is often more important than taste.
relics.unlock: Participate at least 5 times in a row in a [Northwizard Cup] event

relics.name: Seaweed Salad
relics.effect: +1 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +1 ASPD
relics.flavor: Once a national delicacy of great pride to the Iberians, now gradually slipping away from memory as a result of the rampaging Seaborn.

relics.name: Orange Storm
relics.effect: +1 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +1% ATK
relics.flavor: A Mama John's candy product. The orange flavor, cheap and delicious, is a best-seller among children.

relics.name: Coffee Plains Coffee Candy
relics.effect: +2 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +2 ASPD
relics.flavor: Dossoles' famous coffee-flavored candy product. Has real caffeine added, to keep you wide awake from clock-in to overtime.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 70 Operators

relics.name: Screaming Cherry
relics.effect: +2 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +2% ATK
relics.flavor: A Mama John's candy product. Though the niche vinegar-pickled cherry flavor can't compete with the best-sellers in popularity, there have always been a small group of loyal and dedicated consumers. Rumor has it that one of Mama John's directors loves this flavor.

relics.name: Pitt's Assorted Fruits
relics.effect: +3 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +3% ATK, DEF, and HP
relics.flavor: Pitt's assorted fruit candies compete with Mama John's line of products in the sweets market with a rich taste and superb cost-effectiveness. Muelsyse's favorite.
relics.unlock: Reach a Squad Size Limit of 13 at any point

relics.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
relics.effect: +1 Squad Size Limit, +1 Deployment Limit, +1 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: Coffee growers feed their beans to a rare, unusual-smelling breed of fowlbeast before extracting and processing them from its excrement. The unique aroma produced by the beast's gastric acid fermentation triples the price of the coffee beans.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 120 Operators

relics.name: Blue Silk Scarf
relics.effect: Hope +2, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.

relics.name: Originium Iris
relics.effect: Hope +6, Squad Size Limit +2
relics.flavor: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 60 Max Hope

relics.name: Weird Flute
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.

relics.name: Glass Bird
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope

relics.name: Pure Gold Expedition
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 150 Hope

relics.name: 'Durin Overground'
relics.effect: +4 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: In this expedition account, we get a glimpse of how those who live underground see those who live on the surface.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 50 Life Points

relics.name: 'Gaulish Toponym Origins'
relics.effect: +6 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: A book of historical place names that Mint dug out of the Doctor's office. Calais-blason is mentioned in the book.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Points

relics.name: Hot Water Kettle
relics.effect: +1 Max Life Points, +1 Hope
relics.flavor: Some people regularly use the water boiler in the Rhodes Island office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...

relics.name: Special Suppressor
relics.effect: +2 Max Life Points, recover 2 Life Points
relics.flavor: An enhanced suppressor developed by Rhodes Island that can better keep the Infected from losing control of their Originium Arts.

relics.name: Stone Gargoyle
relics.effect: +3 Max Life Points
relics.flavor: A palm-sized sculpture. Supposedly these are handmade gifts given out by the Gargoyles as a sign of friendship.

relics.name: Vampire's Bed
relics.effect: +4 Max Life Points
relics.flavor: A lavish-looking coffin that matches the castle's aesthetics well. However, Warfarin says this is merely a stereotype.

relics.name: Proof of Longevity
relics.effect: +6 Max Life Points
relics.flavor:
A tree branch that has withered and flourished.
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.

relics.name: Banshee's Kiss
relics.effect: Hope +8
relics.flavor: Outsiders make extraordinary displays of bravery that far surpass their normal abilities. However, as one of the few male Banshees out there, this has become far too common a sight to Logos.

relics.name: Flawless Jadestone
relics.effect: Immediately gain 25 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: Even though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargonian emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 20 Originium Ingots remaining

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Vanguard Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: A formidable set of equipment to provide strength, an indomitable heart to press forward bravely.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Guard Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Some people use swords because they don't know how to use crossbows or Arts. Others use swords because that's all they need.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Defender Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Scars symbolize glory, but who will remember the soldiers who were cut a bit too deeply?

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Sniper Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Either you learn to control your ignition, or you learn to discern your target. Got it?'

relics.name: Broken Wand - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Caster Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'After watching the 'performance' of certain casters, I decided to quietly put away the Leithanian textbook.'

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Supporter Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Their tactics are always diverse and colorful.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Medic Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: When the day comes when everyone is a doctor and can even cure the disease known as life, we will no longer need doctors.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Specialist Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: When conducting live combat drills with Specialist Operators, please be prepared to be 'beaten up thoroughly before you are prepared.'

relics.name: Victorian 'Scrap' Medal
relics.effect: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles
relics.flavor: A knight's medal that Siege threw together and awarded to Dagda on the spot. The materials used are pitiful, but it holds a lot of meaning to Dagda.

relics.name: Spectrum Analyzer
relics.effect: Anti-Interference Index +1, +2 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: Please be careful regarding the abnormal phenomena in Sami. The results from measuring electromagnetic radiation and analyzing the specimen's micro-crystals are completely incompatible.

relics.name: Leisure Time
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, Anti-Interference Index +1
relics.flavor: The children are experts at picking up all sorts of things to build their own play-kingdom. The wetland dwellers are accustomed to the outsiders always abruptly abandoning their vehicles halfway to their destination.

relics.name: Tranquil Spring Current
relics.effect: Gain +2 Anti-Interference Index, +3 Max Life Points, and +3 Hope
relics.flavor: After escaping a siege of wind and snow by following the sound of water drops, this specimen has become a protective charm for the research team.

relics.name: Assault Co-op - Sharp Blade
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Vanguard and Guard Operators by +8% for each Vanguard or Guard Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Use the sharpest spear to strike the hardest shield. I guarantee you that the shield will break first, trust me.

relics.name: Assault Co-op - Skirmish
relics.effect: Increases the DEF of Vanguard and Guard Operators by +10% for each Vanguard or Guard Operator in the combat squad
