relics.flavor: A sophisticated blocking technique is essential to protecting one's body.

relics.name: Fortification Co-op - Phalanx
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Defender and Supporter Operators by +8% for each Defender or Supporter Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Like a huge ship running over rubble.

relics.name: Fortification Co-op - Resolution
relics.effect: Increases the DEF of Defender and Supporter Operators by +10% for each Defender or Supporter Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Use the hardest shield to block the sharpest spear. I guarantee you that the spear will break first, trust me.

relics.name: Ranged Co-op - Remote Strike
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Medic and Sniper Operators by +8% for each Medic or Sniper Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: If you can solve the problem from a reasonable distance, why do you have to literally butt heads?

relics.name: Ranged Co-op - Assassination
relics.effect: Increases the ASPD of Medic and Sniper Operators by +6 for each Medic or Sniper Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Can't tell friends from foes at this distance? Unload a volley at them then. The enemies are the ones that failed to avoid it.

relics.name: Sabotage Co-op - Elimination
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Caster and Specialist Operators by +8% for each Caster or Specialist Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: External destruction, internal disintegration.

relics.name: Sabotage Co-op - Suppression
relics.effect: Increases the ASPD of Caster and Specialist Operators by +6 for each Caster or Specialist Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Don’t worry about accuracy. Take enough shots, and you’re guaranteed to land something!

relics.name: Fissured Restraints
relics.effect: All enemy units have -7% ATK
relics.flavor: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

relics.name: Abyssal Wyrdmask
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% ATK
relics.flavor: An eldritch mask not belonging to any culture you're familiar with, capable of making people lose their will to fight... and unconsciously fall into a state of deep contemplation.
relics.unlock: Select 'Leader Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Godmother's Token
relics.effect: All enemy units have -17% ATK
relics.flavor: A laurel of bones, the token of Signora Sicilia. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

relics.name: Worn-out Group Photo
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% DEF
relics.flavor: Do you know someone in the photo?

relics.name: Sea Terror Jerky
relics.effect: All enemy units have -21% DEF
relics.flavor: Once their desire to survive overwhelms their terror, the famished Iberians will devour this 'food,' subsequently turning into Sea Terrors on some ordinary day.
relics.unlock: Select 'Gathering Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
relics.effect: All enemy units have -30% DEF
relics.flavor: 'Who will be the judge?'

relics.name: Gold-Plated Die
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP
relics.flavor: The gold-plated die has one side representing life. As for the other nineteen sides...
relics.unlock: Select 'First-Class Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -10% HP
relics.flavor: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

relics.name: 'The Profound Silence'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -20% HP
relics.flavor: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

relics.name: Oriron Round Shield
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% DEF
relics.flavor: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.

relics.name: Military Mirror Armor
relics.effect: All friendly units have +25% DEF
relics.flavor: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.
relics.unlock: Select 'Spearhead Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Old Steam Armor
relics.effect: All friendly units have +35% DEF
relics.flavor: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.

relics.name: Emperor's Favor
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.

relics.name: Royal Rapier
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.
relics.unlock: Clear [Halfway on Khaganquest] without losing more than 3 Life Points

relics.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
relics.effect: All friendly melee units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.

relics.name: Necklace of the Presence
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.

relics.name: Silver Forks
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it.
relics.unlock: Clear [Long-sought Compensation] without losing more than 3 Life Points

relics.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
relics.effect: All friendly ranged units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.

relics.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
relics.effect: All friendly units have +20% HP
relics.flavor: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'

relics.name: First Aid Kit
relics.effect: All friendly units have +35% HP
relics.flavor: '...Please use antibiotics and ethanol additives under the supervision of professionals...' —Rim Billiton Production Safety Manual
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Unknown Instrument
relics.effect: All friendly units have +50% HP
relics.flavor: Don't ask. It's for your own good.

relics.name: Rusted Razor
relics.effect: All enemies take +15% Physical damage
relics.flavor: If you cut yourself with this, you know what will happen.

relics.name: Carriage Driver's Whip
relics.effect: All enemies take +25% Physical damage
relics.flavor: As the troupe's carriage driver, he has no name and no past. His life is meaningful only when he whips his burdenbeasts.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'Avenger'
relics.effect: All enemies take +35% Physical damage
relics.flavor: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Commission.

relics.name: Standard Anti-Riot Instrument
relics.effect: All enemies take +20% Arts damage
relics.flavor: Standard equipment of the Ursus Guard. Comes with an intermittent blinding Originium Arts effect. Unfortunately, not many Guards out there remember this when push comes to shove.

relics.name: Emperor's Collection
relics.effect: All enemies take +30% Arts damage
relics.flavor: The Sami revere their wild lands more than anything, and this fragment of the vast wilderness sleeps in the personal collection of the Emperor of Ursus.
relics.unlock: Select 'Special Training Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
relics.effect: All enemies take +40% Arts damage
relics.flavor: Their blood yet flows. He should not have left this place.

relics.name: Live Rose
relics.effect: All friendly units receive +20% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it her who protects you?

relics.name: White Flower Crown
relics.effect: All friendly units receive +30% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recover at least 500000 HP

relics.name: Actor's Perfume
relics.effect: All friendly units recover 1% of their Max HP per second
relics.flavor: Troupe actors put this on before going onstage. Stable yet aromatic fragrances like this can help them ease pressure. That's how it seems on the surface, at least.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recover at least 250000 HP

relics.name: Designer's Ruler
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% Physical Dodge
relics.flavor: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several orders of magnitude luckier.

relics.name: 'Arts Killer'
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.

relics.name: Dancer's Bracelets
relics.effect: All friendly units have +10% Physical and Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: The audience breaks into applause as the well-trained dancers waltz around the traps on stage. None of them are aware of the brushes with death the performers have just been through.
relics.unlock: Clear the 4th Floor [Gelid Rockshelves]

relics.name: Doll House
relics.effect: +10 Starting DP
relics.flavor: All kids need at least one set.

relics.name: Miniature Stage Model
relics.effect: +20 Starting DP
relics.flavor: The red paint has not yet dried. Careful. Don't get that paint on your hand.

relics.name: Dreambind Castle Model
relics.effect: +30 Starting DP
relics.flavor: You've seen this place, and you once wandered the castle, yet you now hold it in your hand. Is this real, or is it all a dream?
relics.unlock: Clear the 2nd Floor [Immaculate Garden]

relics.name: Jet-Black Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Melee Operators on High Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Columbian dancer's steps are firm and strong, her taps reverberating loudly in the air as she strikes the ground.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor [Dawning Frostbounds] a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

relics.name: Pure White Dance Shoes
relics.effect: Can deploy Ranged Operators on Low Ground tiles
relics.flavor: The Ursus dancer's steps are swift and elegant, her body moving as she wills.
relics.unlock: Clear the 3rd Floor [Dawning Frostbounds] a total of 3 times, with 6 or more Ranged or Melee Operators recruited

relics.name: Ancient Gaulish Silver Coin
relics.effect: All Operators start with +6 SP
relics.flavor: A coin once circulated in the now fallen nation of 'Gaul.' It is in very good shape, making it highly valuable as a collector's item.

relics.name: Bank of Gaul Check
relics.effect: All Operators start with +12 SP
relics.flavor: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

relics.name: 'Second Economic Reform Act'
relics.effect: All Operators start with +18 SP
relics.flavor: With this bill as the starting point, Gaul formally began its path to become a hegemonic empire.

relics.name: Vanilla Soda
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s
relics.flavor: Bolívar's cheap specialty drink dates back hundreds of years. It is mixed with a variety of spices, and is known for not being very good.

relics.name: Fowlbeast Liver Pate
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.35/s
relics.flavor: A small jar of fowlbeast liver pâté. Bright and vividly colorful, it is eaten only by nobles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Dreaming Essence
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.5/s
relics.flavor: Supposedly the Banshees make their aromatics only for their beloved. A single drop is enough to enchant just about anyone, bringing out any artist's inspiration and creativity.

relics.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 3s
relics.flavor: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria's bustling cities, it is now discontinued.

relics.name: Water of Life
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 2.5s
relics.flavor: The strongest Ursus liquors go straight to one's head, but it's said that the healthy Ursusian adult can down several bottles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure.

relics.name: Royal Liqueur
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills by 1 SP per 1.5s
relics.flavor: The fine wines of the fallen nation of Gaul have now become prized treasures for collectors. The place of production has moved to Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.

relics.name: String Puppet
relics.effect: Enemies receive 700 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?

relics.name: 'Children's Puppet'
relics.effect: Enemies receive 1000 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.

relics.name: Victory Horn
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 100%
relics.flavor: Blow the horn, cry out, and scatter our foes with its roar!

relics.name: Flash Camera
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 110%
relics.flavor: Every photo shot by this camera is washed out in white, with only the victim's twisted expression faintly visible.
relics.unlock: Win a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

relics.name: Therapy Tape
relics.effect: Increases the duration of single-instance status effects such as stun, cold, or freeze by 150%
relics.flavor: He tried to stop you from listening. He said it was dangerous. He said you should not stay. Do you understand now? You are listening to his song.

relics.name: Old Fan
relics.effect: All Operators gain +10% ATK for every different type of Operator class in the squad
relics.flavor: When it rains for several days on end, the old Yanese Tianshi complains to his friends about the pain in his knees, before casually waving his fan and driving away the rainclouds. It is about time he taught this trick to his young apprentice, currently working at the Central Judicial Office.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure while having at least 20 Operators

relics.name: Nachzehrer's Cane
relics.effect: When a friendly unit is overhealed, nearby enemies take Arts damage equal to the overheal amount
relics.flavor: Life is the Nachzehrer's sustenance and currency.
relics.unlock: Win a battle while having at least 3 Medic Operators

relics.name: Scout's Scope
relics.effect: Enemies take increased damage from friendly units as range increases (max 100%)
relics.flavor: Lock on, aim, fire, and destroy the enemy's will to resist, all in the name of a better future that Scout will never see. Maybe you can do it for him.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Fallen Snowpriest] 2 times

relics.name: Black Tulip
relics.effect: Friendly Operators gradually gain ATK when not using a skill, up to a maximum of +60% after 60 seconds; bonus is reset when skill ends
relics.flavor: The Silence crushed the Iberians, so she wishes to speak up. If her words are not sharp enough, then her sword will speak for her.

relics.name: Spinach Pack
relics.effect: All friendly units have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.

relics.name: Wrath of Siracusans
relics.effect: All friendly units have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
relics.unlock: Clear [Rock and a Hard Place] without losing more than 3 Life Points

relics.name: King's New Lance
relics.effect: When Life Point is 1, all friendly units have +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Beautiful wishes made in dire straits can bring hope, even if they are not necessarily the truth.

relics.name: Castle's Offspring
relics.effect: All Operators gain +300 DEF and +30 RES after being deployed for 100 seconds
relics.flavor: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

relics.name: King's Buckler
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators have +2 Block
relics.flavor: Keep your eyes straight ahead, and let your stalwart heart resist all hardship.

relics.name: King's Staff
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all Operators recover an additional 1 SP every 2 seconds
relics.flavor: Let go of worthless pomp and treat others with kindness. They will no doubt return in kind.

relics.name: King's Crown
relics.effect: When Life Point is at 1, all friendly units have +50% ATK, increased to +150% ATK if you have collected 3 or more King's Collectibles
relics.flavor: O Nameless King, may you continue to bless Iberia, even should your kingdom fall to ruin.

relics.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
relics.effect: Operators gain +70% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.

relics.name: 'The Return'
relics.effect: Operators gain +130% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

relics.name: 'Devotion'
relics.effect: Ranged Operators deal 150 Arts damage to a random enemy within attack range with every attack or heal
relics.flavor: Since antiquity, this tribe has believed that they hold a truth about Sami: Everything originally had a voice, until 'It' spoke for all of them.

relics.name: Celestial Dust
relics.effect: Ranged Operators Levitate all enemies within attack range for 2 seconds when a skill is manually activated
relics.flavor: She gently blows away the countless records of sunrises, moonsets, and the changing of the stars. Her life is blown away that easily.

relics.name: Frozen Husk
relics.effect: Melee Operators gain ASPD +40 for 5 seconds after taking damage
relics.flavor: The warriors of Sami stationed in the Fjal Vetrtonn are often inspired by an illusion: As their life flows toward the earth, their originally frozen bodies become lighter and lighter.

relics.name: Ring of Thorns
relics.effect: When Melee Operators are healed, they and Operators in the adjacent 4 tiles will recover 1 SP
relics.flavor: You were able to steady yourself while in a distorted fear. There is blood left on the thorns, and you don't know if it was you or the Snowpriest who was pricked by them. They will use whatever means they have, without batting an eye.

relics.name: 'Peek into the Eternal Night'
relics.effect: All Operators gain ATK +25% and ASPD +25, but lose 25 HP every second
relics.flavor: The moment she turns around to head north, mountains in black lie before her eyes, just like the omen she saw many years ago.

relics.name: 'Dead Tree's Echo'
relics.effect: All Operators recover 50 HP every second, but have Max HP -25%
relics.flavor: Drum to call their ancestors' souls, drum to communicate with the vegetation, drum to exorcise evil spirits. Shaman after shaman have received this beastbone hammer, some leaving a longer echo than the others.

relics.name: Frozen Whetstone
relics.effect: When a battle begins, the Max HP, ATK, DEF, RES, Block Count, Starting SP, and DP Cost of a random Operator is doubled
relics.flavor: The stone's surface is smooth as ice. The maker asked the mountain cliffs for permission to replicate their overpowering strength in their blade.

relics.name: Clairvoyant's Reveal
relics.effect: The DP Cost and Redeployment Time of all Operators is randomly changed
relics.flavor: There is no direction you can head to avoid misfortune.

relics.name: Weave of Thorns and Leaves
relics.effect: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; allied units deployed on that tile or its surrounding 8 tiles will gain Camouflage
relics.flavor: Those within this ring receive the favor of the thorns and leaves.

relics.name: Living Woodplate
relics.effect: All allied melee units gain a Barrier equal to 50% of their Max HP on deployment
relics.flavor: The shamans know how trees will cling to survival, so they invite the trees to become armor for a warrior possessing a similar will.

relics.name: Finshell Shield
relics.effect: All allied ranged units gain 3 layers of Shield on deployment
relics.flavor: The stacks of distant trauma cannot surpass the layers of protection built by the body.

relics.name: Frost Buck's Pauldron
relics.effect: All allied units gain ATK +40% and DEF +40% for 30 seconds when blocking 2 or more enemies
relics.flavor: There are no signs of injuries on his body, only a pair of eyes drained of blood and tears.
relics.unlock: Win a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

relics.name: Snow Doe's Glove
relics.effect: All allied units gain ASPD +80 and obtain 50% Physical and Arts Dodge for 30 seconds when blocking 3 or more enemies
relics.flavor: She shoots the last three arrows in her quiver at the Frozen Monstrosity, who used them to end her life.

relics.name: Empty Fowlbeast
relics.effect: Summons gain Max HP +30%, ATK +30%, and grant ATK +60% to their summoner
relics.flavor: The body is long since gone, but the soul remains in the shell for eternity. The unmelting creatures in the branches and leaves carry icicles as they spread their wings in the forest.

relics.name: Rock Horn
relics.effect: All Operators gain ATK +20% for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles
relics.flavor: If you want to gather up manpower in Sami, blowing a trumpet is definitely the best way to do it.

relics.name: Inextinguishable Torch
relics.effect: All Operators gain ASPD +30 for every Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles
relics.flavor: Flames represent radiance and warmth. Gathering round a fire turns despair into hope.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 200 Operator deployments in battle

relics.name: Lakebed Aegis
relics.effect: Objective Shield +1; all allied units gain Max HP +60% if you have any Objective Shield at the beginning of a battle
relics.flavor: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.

relics.name: Ancient Fresco
relics.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 1000 Arts damage and are Silenced for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: Walk out of the cave, and raise your head. This has never been right, even since antiquity.

relics.name: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
relics.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 2000 Arts damage and take 30% more damage for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: At that moment, the light of truth shone onto the earth.

relics.name: Cloud-Moving Totem
relics.effect: All enemies have -15% Movement Speed, and the Weightless effect further drops their Weight Level by 2
relics.flavor: The Sami tribe that believes in the King of Fowlbeasts created this totem. It is said that a sincere call will stir its wings, raising a storm and making the earth tremble.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators start with +15 SP
relics.flavor: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Forthpath Search] event 2 times

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills is decreased by -35%
relics.flavor: As an operator who often enters the battlefield before anyone else, you cannot fathom what they have been through.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Forthpath Search] event 4 times

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have +50% ATK and DEF
relics.flavor: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Forthpath Search] event 6 times

relics.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The soldiers stepped onto the battlefield, drew their blades, and met in battle.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
relics.effect: Guard Operators have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Amma Tal] event 2 times

relics.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
relics.effect: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack
relics.flavor: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Amma Tal] event 4 times

relics.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Amma Tal] event 6 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
relics.effect: Defender Operators have -3 DP Cost and +40% HP
relics.flavor: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
relics.effect: Defender Operators have +60% ATK
relics.flavor: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Wilderness Survival Expert] event 2 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
relics.effect: Defender Operators restore 2 SP after being attacked
relics.flavor: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Wilderness Survival Expert] event 6 times

relics.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
relics.effect: Defender Operators gain HP +40%, DEF +40%, and RES +20
relics.flavor: No matter how hard fate hits you, just take it in.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Wilderness Survival Expert] event 4 times

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +20% ATK
relics.flavor: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Rain!] event 2 times

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -40% HP, but gain +40% ATK
relics.flavor: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Rain!] event 4 times

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +70 ASPD
relics.flavor: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria could almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Rain!] event 6 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving
relics.effect: Caster Operators have +25% ATK and +25 ASPD
relics.flavor: Those who gaze up at the great spires of Leithanien often see strange or even celestial phenomena.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Missing Mountains] event 2 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s
relics.flavor: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Missing Mountains] event 4 times

relics.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -40% HP, but deal +70% Arts damage
relics.flavor: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Missing Mountains] event 6 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
relics.effect: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills is decreased by -40%
relics.flavor: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Useless Objects] event 2 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
relics.effect: Friendly units within the attack range of Supporter Operators gain +20% ATK
relics.flavor: Bringing meals, showing the right route to take, or even having a heart-to-heart. The key difference between victory and defeat often lies in these little things.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Useless Objects] event 6 times

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
relics.effect: Enemies within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -20% DEF and -20% RES
relics.flavor: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Useless Objects] event 4 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
relics.effect: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s
relics.flavor: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Good Omen] event 2 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
relics.effect: Medic Operators gain +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Compared to the feat of snatching a life from the grip of death, what is three days of coma afterwards?
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Good Omen] event 4 times

relics.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
relics.effect: Allied units within the attack range of Medic Operators gain Resistance
relics.flavor: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Good Omen] event 6 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: There may be many means, but only one end.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
relics.effect: Specialist Operators gain +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: An endless amount of rust to scrape off, and an endless amount of work.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Lowland Market] event 2 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
relics.effect: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%
relics.flavor: Sound is eliminated the moment the shadows pass by, and whoever hears them is next.
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Lowland Market] event 4 times

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Spearhead Sharpening
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +40% ATK and +2 shift strength
relics.flavor: 'Try this new weapon out—or did you already try it out just now?
relics.unlock: Across all adventures, enter the [Lowland Market] event 6 times

relics.name: Hand of Buckler
relics.effect: Decel Binder, Hexer, and Abjurer Operators' attacks deal additional Arts damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP
relics.flavor: Drop by drop, bit by bit. It is unstoppable.

relics.name: Hand of Diffusion
relics.effect: Fortress, Chain Caster, and Blast Caster Operators recover 2 SP each time they deal damage to an enemy unit
relics.flavor: Strength in numbers.

relics.name: Hand of Superspeed
relics.effect: Executor, Ambusher, and Dollkeeper Operators gain +120 ASPD when there are no friendly units in the four adjacent tiles
relics.flavor: You swing your hand, leaving not even an afterimage.

relics.name: Hand of Purification
relics.effect: Bard, Phalanx Caster, and Therapist Operators deal 50% ATK as Arts damage per second to all enemies in their attack range
relics.flavor: Where it is, dust is not.

relics.name: Hand of Pulverization
relics.effect: Artilleryman, Splash Caster, and Flinger Operators gain +15% ATK for every time they deal damage to the same unit, up to 150%; this bonus will reset if no damage is dealt for 5 seconds
relics.flavor: Your goal isn't just to hit the bullseye over and over.

relics.name: Hand of Flowing Water
relics.effect: Increases the SP recovery rate of Core Caster, Mystic Caster, and Summoner Operators by +0.5/s whenever they use a skill, up to 4 stacks
relics.flavor: The ocean's flow never ceases, because it is always surging.

relics.name: Hand of Fisticuffs
relics.effect: Protector, Arts Protector, and Duelist Operators inflict Bind on all nearby enemies lasting 1 second every 2 seconds, and deal True damage equal to 100% of their ATK
relics.flavor: What she means by standing over there, is that you cannot cross.

relics.name: Hand of Adaptability
relics.effect: Charger, Pioneer, and Tactician Operators have -10 DP Cost, and after defeating an enemy grant -1 DP Cost to all undeployed Operators on their next deployment
relics.flavor: What we lack now is not battlefield intelligence, but a captain who is able to finish reading said intelligence in time.

relics.name: Hand of Outburst
relics.effect: Heavyshooter, Deadeye, and Besieger Operators deal increasing damage to enemies as the target's HP decreases, up to a maximum of 50%, and instantly defeat enemies below 20% HP
relics.flavor: Smash open every single crack, or perhaps make the very first.

relics.name: Condensed Suppressant
relics.effect: All friendly units increase their ATK to 150% and silence the enemy for 3 seconds when attacking [Infected Creatures]
relics.flavor: A medical reagent developed by Rhodes Island to suppress acute Oripathy infections. However, further enrichment of its concentration will cause irreversible damage to the infection site.
relics.unlock: Find and destroy an 'Infused Glacial Originium Slug' or 'Infused Glacial Originium Slug α'

relics.name: Antique Casting
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Harken, the forge of the sky, awaits five earthborn metals'... Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, promote a total of 35 Operators

relics.name: Draft of a Speech
relics.effect: All Operators cost -2 Hope to recruit
relics.flavor: She was a little nervous, a little worried, but still remained resolute. When the microphone was turned on, her long ears quivered slightly.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 100 Operators

relics.name: Rusted Iron Hammer
relics.effect: Rogue Trader charges -50% Originium Ingots for their goods
relics.flavor: 'Change is necessary, and we must do all we can to hasten the oncoming storm.'

relics.name: Four-Leaf Clover Fossil
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when loot drops from a Wish Fulfilled node or after battle
relics.flavor: A symbol of luck that Magallan found in a place all but devoid of life. The rock has no doubt experienced many violent changes of the lands, but it survived, giving those who come across it a small bit of lingering hope.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 150 Collectibles

relics.name: Acahuallan Bowl
relics.effect: Recover 4 Life Points, +2 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.

relics.name: Three-Dimensional Art Display
relics.effect: Recover 7 Life Points, and recover an additional 1 Life Point after each battle
relics.flavor: The impression that Rhine Lab often gives is akin to this work of art: inscrutable, multi-faceted, and impossible to sift fact from fiction.
relics.unlock: Clear the 1st Floor [Brisk Marshlands]

relics.name: Defender-2
relics.effect: +5 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: A mass-produced defensive-type drone. It doesn't make sense how it only seems to be useful in the hands of the enemy.

relics.name: Golden Chalice
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all friendly units have +7 ASPD
relics.flavor: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!

relics.name: 'King's Fellowship'
relics.effect: +2 Objective Shield, coverts all Life Points into an equivalent amount of Objective Shield (Cannot be reduced below 1 by this effect)
relics.flavor: The Cultists of the Deep did not achieve success overnight; they lingered at the junction between land and sea for ages, preparing for the calamity that would come to be known as the Profound Silence.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 20 victories with 1 Life Point remaining

relics.name: Knight Lance Pro
relics.effect: Treasure Chests on the battlefield will drop more Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: Don't worry if your own strength isn't enough! Use these tiny levers to move more, and win more in every round! The grand prize is a holiday trip to Sami!

relics.name: Full-Auto Maintenance Station
relics.effect: Anti-Interference Index +2, but +2 Collapse value
relics.flavor: It's a little dirty, but can run on complete full-auto. And, for reasons no one knows, even runs from morning to night when no one's using it. Raythean Industries claims to have never designed such a product.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, enter a total of 40 non-combat nodes

relics.name: Warning Fence
relics.effect: -2 Collapse value, +2 Max Life Points
relics.flavor: The colorful decorations stand out in the snow, letting people imagine them clearly even in their dreams. The territory has no borders, but the roaming mind needs to know where fear is lurking.

relics.name: 'Heavy Music Anthology'
relics.effect: -2 Collapse value, Hope +2
relics.flavor: Every winter, Colombian rescue crews stationed in southern Sami have several missions to rescue bands who get lost in the snowy woods while filming music videos.

relics.name: Wandering Caster's Nostalgia
relics.effect: When entering Secluded Passage, -3 Collapse value
relics.flavor: Someone has copied these notes down in a desperate attempt to remember them. The melody performed by the blade cutting through the air is strangely harmonious, but does not follow the equal temperament of music at all.

relics.name: Ceremony Bell
relics.effect: Recover 1 Life Point whenever you lose Anti-Interference Index
relics.flavor: Close your eyes. Look inward for all that you crave.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader [Weaving Vinecreeps] 2 times

relics.name: Northern Pioneer's Crutch
relics.effect: When Anti-Interference Index is no less than 4, gain +2 Originium Ingots whenever you enter a non-combat node
relics.flavor: It can detect some types of hazards, but more importantly, it can detect coins. According to the terms of the contract, the company will only bear the costs of the Pioneers' medical insurance after a local medical institute adhering to Columbian standards has been established.

relics.name: Hunters' Insight
relics.effect: All Operators ignore 50% DEF and RES when attacking [Collapsals], and Slow them for 0.5 sec
relics.flavor: Before her will is completely wrested away, the girl begs the rescuer approaching her: 'Let me draw the bowstring, let me defeat it, let me never fear.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat a total of 200 'Tainted Carcass'

relics.name: Weave of Snow and Soil
relics.effect: Designates one deployable tile at the beginning of battle; allied Operators deployed on that tile or its surrounding 8 tiles will grant 1 SP to another Operator within those tiles whenever they gain SP from Offensive or Defensive Recovery
relics.flavor: Those within this ring receive the attention of the snow and earth.

relics.name: Ancient Tree Fruit
relics.effect: Immediately obtain 3 random trinkets
relics.flavor: The children of Sami made their wishes into tree seeds, and buried them in the snow. When the tree bears fruit, the first four are taken, and the smallest is left for future generations to make their wishes. The remaining fruits are tributes to Sami, praying for answers.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain 50 Collectibles

relics.name: Polar Retrofit Package
relics.effect: When used, Support items will also be used simultaneously on the adjacent 4 tiles
relics.flavor: Proudly produced by the Volvort Kochinski Extreme Environment Equipment Testing Department. It can modify a variety of devices, adapting them for polar regions and increasing their effectiveness in cold environments.
relics.unlock: Select 'Support Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Roundstone Altar
relics.effect: There is a chance after battle to permanently increase all allied units' ATK and DEF by 5% (Can stack up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: Offer a sacrifice, and receive a reward. It is so convenient that the people never think about what they are directing their sacrifices to.

relics.name: Rainbow Jar
relics.effect: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, immediately selects a random Operator waiting to be re-deployable, and reduces their Redeployment Time by half
relics.flavor: It is usually placed by the Sami people wherever the rainbow falls. They are meticulously maintained in order to withstand the untraceable catastrophes, both natural and man-made.

relics.name: Sprouted Stick
relics.effect: Gain +2 Objective Shield when entering Bosky Passage or Lost and Found nodes
relics.flavor: It accompanied a sturdy and swarthy Kuranta out of the country of sand, accompanied him, the Director of Rhine Lab's Scientific Investigation Section, into the silverwhite plains. Even though it was separated from its owner in an accident, it can still bring its wielder a revelation about survival.

relics.name: Cannot's Mark
relics.effect: Gain 1 Hope whenever you buy an item at the Rogue Trader or make an exchange at Lost and Found
relics.flavor: Some people are willing to do Cannot a favor, and some are worthy for Cannot to do a 'favor.'
relics.unlock: In the 'Prospective Investment System,' reach an Investment Reserve Balance of 325

relics.name: Guiding Vinedoll
relics.effect: Anti-Interference Index has a chance to not decrease when traveling through a vertical path
relics.flavor: The shamans often make these little puppets out of vines to navigate the forest. Even though they are not very accurate, striking true can conserve a lot of the survey equipment's energy.

relics.name: Broken Ursus Blade
relics.effect: Gain Command EXP +10% for each level of Collapsal Paradigm
relics.flavor: It was not for a lack of determination; his willpower is beyond question. It was only that, at that moment of self-determination, his body instinctively committed an irreversible mistake.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, defeat the Leader ['Demon's Blade'] 2 times

relics.name: Slytooth, Forest Destroyer
relics.effect: Battles have a chance to drop an extra 1 Foldartal
relics.flavor: When it discovered that humans were willing to exchange tree fruits for wood chips, this musbeast began to unscrupulously devour the forest bark for more chips. It may not have expected that many of those chips would embody Sami's supreme will.

relics.name: Treescar Helm
relics.effect: +3 Hope; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: It carries status and power, but to the warrior, it is only an artificial object for the weak to protect themselves. Some discard it to abandon their duty, some discard it only to strengthen their resolve to give up their lives.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

relics.name: Boundless Gift
relics.effect: +3 Collapse value; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: Takes root in regions unperceivable, absorbs nutrients in places unimaginable. The flowers bloom across the vastness, becoming the very first signal beacon outside the border.

relics.name: Routeweave Net
relics.effect: Additional enemies appear in battle; leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: An intricate network is woven into a map that no one understands. It shows what seems to be a path that extends in all directions, but what it actually displays is only the result.

relics.name: 'Sui's Wrath'
relics.effect: Whenever you deploy a unit, deal 3000 Arts damage to a random enemy and the area around it
relics.flavor: The Feranmut lifts Its head, heaven and earth cower in fear.
relics.unlock: Win a battle while having at least 3 Specialist Operators

relics.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
relics.effect: All enemies take +150% True damage
relics.flavor: A small, black crown.

relics.name: 'End of Times'
relics.effect: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
relics.flavor: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
relics.unlock: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Points (including mission failures)

relics.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
relics.effect: Deals Stun to all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
relics.flavor: The illumination device produced after reverse engineering the Eye of Iberia. It is powerful enough to penetrate layers of dark clouds, as well as temporarily repel powerful enemies.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Life Points

relics.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
relics.effect: Deals 3000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point
relics.flavor: 'It has pierced Victoria's heart, and is watching the empire bleed.'

relics.name: 'Blindness'
relics.effect: When Anti-Interference Index is at 0 to 1, moving horizontally or vertically will randomly grant you Objective Shield, Originium Ingot, Hope, Anti-Interference Index, or Foldartal
relics.flavor: These days, there is no one capable of determining if they still retain the structure of a Sarkaz Royal Court, or if they still have a King within. The final memory that everyone can recall is the moment when a certain Cyclopes took off the black crown atop their head.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 30 Life Points lost

relics.name: Scarred Amber
relics.effect: Uncaps Anti-Interference Index Limit, and every surplus index point will grant all allied units HP +8% and ATK +8%
relics.flavor: The elves have been left so alone on Terra that they embrace the dust with their backs to a foreign land.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, obtain a total of 20 Anti-Interference Index

relics.name: Amma's Affection
relics.effect: All allied units gain +1% HP, ATK, and DEF; occasionally something wonderful will happen
relics.flavor: It does love you, as is evident from the weight in your pocket, but Its love is fleeting and fickle, and you never know if what you retrieve from your pocket will be proof of Its protection or a handful of melted snow.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

relics.name: Horizon Invitation
relics.effect: Leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: An invitation to the end of the icefield, distributed or sold through secret channels to those deserving. However, obtaining this invitation is merely the first step, and the test is yet to come—
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Dimensional Fluid
relics.effect: Leads expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: A raw material developed by integrating technology from multiple nations and results from deep-dives into Collapsal research. After passing the test, the Rhodes Island operator officially hands it to you along with a message: 'Deliver it safely to the end of the icefield, where Kal'tsit waits for you.'
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Collapsal Seed
relics.effect: All friendly units have -15% ATK and -15% HP
relics.flavor: Traces of Collapse remain here, refusing to be removed.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Fragment of Space
relics.effect: -4 Squad Size Limit
relics.flavor: The space here has been indiscriminately torn to shreds, leaving only a tiny piece.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: Profound Scorchmarks
relics.effect: -12 Max Life Point
relics.flavor: The boundless energy burned away their body and soul, and they will never recover.
relics.unlock: Reach the ending once after [Expansion II]

relics.name: 'King's Crystal'
relics.effect: At the end of battle, -2 Life Points (will not go lower than 1), +1 Hope, +5 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: The Iberians' contact with the Seaborn goes back further than they can imagine, but they did not know what the Seaborn were back then.

relics.name: 'Blossom'
relics.effect: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Ops [Harass With Strength] without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
relics.effect: Summons will no longer use Deployment slots
relics.flavor: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'

relics.name: Hand of Unyielding
relics.effect: Artificers, Merchants, and Geeks will grant 3 temporary Life Points after being deployed on the field for 30 seconds (Each Operator can only trigger this once per battle)
relics.flavor: Nice to have, even nicer when in danger.

relics.name: Hand of Return
relics.effect: Multi-target Medics, Chain Medics, and Wandering Medics will heal any Operator within their range to full HP when that Operator takes critical damage (Each Operator can only trigger this once per battle)
relics.flavor: Restrain death, and rouse life.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Fuel
relics.effect: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: The flames turn more intense with each additional firewood added to the pile.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Battlecry
relics.effect: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allies gain ATK +8% (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Combat is also a group activity. The more people there are, the more confident they get, and the more powerful they become with weapons in hand.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Rampart
relics.effect: For every Defender Operator on the field, all allies take 10% less physical damage (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Gather sand to form a tower, and gaze upon enemies from above.

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Succession
relics.effect: For every Sniper Operator on the field, all allies gain ASPD +12 (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Hear the sound of the first arrow, as the last pierces the torso.

relics.name: Broken Wand - Harmony
relics.effect: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allies deal +12% Arts damage (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: The solos have their merits, but a chorus can destroy everything.

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Linkup
relics.effect: For every Supporter Operator on the field, increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Hand in hand, shoulder to shoulder, brace yourselves, and look straight ahead.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Wellspring
relics.effect: For every Medic Operator on the field, all allies gain Redeployment Time -5% (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: They are clear springs formed from flowing water, and they heal all that live.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Disturbance
relics.effect: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Delay the enemy bit by bit, just like slicing a sausage, and by the time they realize it there will be nothing they can do.

relics.name: Palmtop Pavilion
relics.effect: All Operators gain +1 Block, and an additional +1 Block after being deployed for more than 60 seconds
relics.flavor: The Tumu Tianshi's masterpiece. Fits in one hand, but throw it to the ground and it turns into the ground floor of the Chamber of Heaven's Designs' outer pavilion. Once a secret of the Tianshi Bureaus, now mass-produced and widely used in garrisons and expeditions on the icefield.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Ops [No More Than Four] without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Minoan Ode
relics.effect: All Allies permanently gain HP +3% for every Emergency Ops cleared (stacks up to 15 times)
relics.flavor: 'Is there a feat more worthy of praise than an expedition into no man's land? Now, yes! Go forth into the north, and write the next chapter of your saga!'

relics.name: Friston.P
relics.effect: All Allies permanently gain ASPD +5 for every Emergency Ops cleared (stacks up to 15 times)
relics.flavor: Friston would certainly not miss out on an opportunity to explore the secrets of another predecessor civilization. Oh, but Closure didn't even consider making backups, so DON'T tell her about this!

relics.name: Vinecreep Mortar Gunner
relics.effect: Enemies defeated while airborne will deal 3000 physical damage to surrounding enemies
relics.flavor: It's no surprise such a fantastical weapon would appear when people from different cultures let down their guard and communicate with sincerity.

relics.name: Northwind Construct
relics.effect: [Machine] and [Arts Creations] enemies will be immediately Frozen with their first attack for 15 seconds
relics.flavor: Though she often fails, she is still committed to helping those who would challenge their tragic fates.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Ops [Manmade Carnival] without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Shattered Alliance Treaty
relics.effect: All Operators receive 50% less damage from Sarkaz and Possessed enemies
relics.flavor: What are the Sarkaz in the eyes of others? Perhaps this object can explain everything.

relics.name: Paradigm Apparatus
relics.effect: All enemies have ASPD -30 when on tiles affected by Dominion
relics.flavor: Naturally, Ursus was unwilling to divulge their research into the Royal Guard to other countries. But ultimately, they caved to international pressure and shared some of their technology—after all, this was all to find the source of the demons.

relics.name: Expeditioner's Field Pack
relics.effect: All Operators gain ATK +60% and Resist for 15 seconds after recovering from a negative status
relics.flavor: They always stuff their backpacks with survival supplies, then press forward with the determination and will to challenge the boundaries of the known.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Ops [Where Ice Condenses] without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Black Hole Protocol
relics.effect: When DP is maxed out, all Operators gain Max HP +150%
relics.flavor: This collaborative operation is unprecedented in the history books. The nations of Terra have invested a great deal of resources into the megastructure in the far north, and the NGO Rhodes Island has become the actual managing party in order to prevent the results from being concealed or tampered with.
relics.unlock: Win Emergency Ops [Payback] without losing any Life Point

relics.name: Featured Canned Meat
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units recover 3 HP per second
relics.flavor: For travelers on a long journey, the convenience of 'ready to eat' is often more important than taste.

relics.name: Seaweed Salad
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units gain +1 ASPD
relics.flavor: Once a beloved Iberian delicacy, now fading from memory due to the rampaging Seaborn.

relics.name: Orange Storm
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, all allied units gain +1% ATK
relics.flavor: A Mama John's candy. The orange flavor, cheap and delicious, is a best-seller among children.

relics.name: Coffee Plains Coffee Candy
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +2, all allied units gain +2 ASPD
relics.flavor: Dossoles' famous coffee-flavored candy with actual caffeine. Perfect for getting through that 15 hour shift.

relics.name: Screaming Cherry
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +2, all allied units gain +2% ATK
relics.flavor: A Mama John's candy. Though the niche vinegar-pickled cherry flavor can't compete with the best-sellers in popularity, it has garnered a small group of loyal supporters. Rumor has it that one of Mama John's directors loves this flavor.

relics.name: Pitt's Assorted Fruits
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +3, all allied units gain +3% ATK, DEF, and HP
relics.flavor: With rich taste and affordable prices, Pitt's assorted fruit candies rival Mama John's in the sweets market. Muelsyse's favorite.

relics.name: Topographical Map
relics.effect: Deployment Limit +1, all allied units gain +4% DEF
relics.flavor: A hand-drawn map exuding antiquity. The labels and terrain are enlarged, and its scale seems to be off.

relics.name: Conch of Divine Whispers
relics.effect: Deployment Limit +1, all allied units gain +4% HP
relics.flavor: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.

relics.name: Night-Whispers in the Forest
relics.effect: Deployment Limit +2, all allied units gain +6% DEF
relics.flavor: A Convalescent Garden aromatherapy set for field operators, featuring fifteen herbal extracts in a hundred and seventy-two combinations. Said to evoke the soothing sense of rustling leaves and gentle chirping.

relics.name: Church Alms Meal Voucher
relics.effect: Deployment Limit +2, all allied units gain +6% HP
relics.flavor: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.

relics.name: Pried Open Toolbox
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: The tool box of the troupe's prop master. From nails to dummy props, it has everything.

relics.name: Antiquated Sheet Music
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.

relics.name: Letter of Termination Contract
relics.effect: Hope +4
relics.flavor: You can break free from this troupe with just one signature.

relics.name: Universal Key
relics.effect: Hope +6
relics.flavor: An old, silver key. It can open any door. As the keeper, the troupe's butler naturally needs a key that unlocks all the secrets here.

relics.name: Banshee's Kiss
relics.effect: Hope +8
relics.flavor: Outbloods show exceptional courage when in possession of this trinket, but to Logos, a rare male Banshee, it's just a common object.

relics.name: Antique Coins
relics.effect: Immediately add +10 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: An ancient, rusty coin, weathered to the point that one can no longer identify its age. Things like these are all too common throughout Terra's barrens.

relics.name: Actor's Jewelry Box
relics.effect: Immediately add 18 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: A box containing all kinds of shattered jewelry. The young lead wore this jewelry and stepped onto the stage, in the end jumping from its highest point.

relics.name: Flawless Jadestone
relics.effect: Immediately add 25 Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: Even though it thrice brought the city to ruins, it yet shines radiantly in its flawless form. Even today, the Sargonian emperor in possession of the gem has yet to find another piece of jewelry matching its brilliance, leaving it with naught but gunsmoke for a companion.

relics.name: Game Room Admin Access Card
relics.effect: Immediately Promote an Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: With this, you have become master over Rhodes Island's entertainment privileges. Please exercise caution when processing the various strange applications from the Operators... and remember to lock the door every day.

relics.name: Miss.Christine Petting Ticket
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 2 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: You have the lady's permission!

relics.name: Red Bow Tie
relics.effect: Hope +2, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.

relics.name: Solo Music Box
relics.effect: Hope +4, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.

relics.name: Supreme Ring
relics.effect: +50% Originium Ingot drops from battle
relics.flavor: In Leithanian mythology, he who holds the ring enjoys the vast riches of the entire world, but greed will also be his undoing.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 20 Originium Ingots remaining

relics.name: Lucky Coin
relics.effect: Gain +2 Originium Ingots upon entering a non-combat node.
relics.flavor: A coin picked up at Rhodes Island. If you find one, you're sure to be able to find many more.

relics.name: Leithanian Medal of Honor
relics.effect: Gain +30% Command EXP from battles
relics.flavor: The twin empresses rarely do anything together, but conferring awards on those who create art is one such thing.

relics.name: Hibernating Kin
relics.effect: Hope +5, obtain an extra Collectible when this Collectible is exchanged in Lost and Found
relics.flavor: Lost in the silver mountain range, the Sarkaz hibernated for self-preservation. It slept so long it nearly lost itself, until its fated kin awoke it. Now, it will follow his path.

relics.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1, Shield +1
relics.flavor: Coffee beans fed to a rare, peculiar-smelling fowlbeast and processed from its excrement. The unique aroma from gastric acid fermentation triples the beans' price.

relics.name: Blue Silk Scarf
relics.effect: Hope +2, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.

relics.name: Originium Iris
relics.effect: Hope +6, Squad Size Limit +2
relics.flavor: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 60 Max Hope

relics.name: Weird Flute
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.

relics.name: Glass Bird
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1
relics.flavor: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 50 Hope

relics.name: Pure Gold Expedition
relics.effect: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1
relics.flavor: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, earn a total of 150 Hope

relics.name: 'Durin Overground'
relics.effect: Shield +4
relics.flavor: In this expedition account, we get a glimpse of how those who live underground see those who live on the surface.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 50 Life Points

relics.name: 'Gaulish Toponym Origins'
relics.effect: Shield +6
relics.flavor: A book of historical place names that Mint dug out of the Doctor's office. Calais-blason is mentioned in the book.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, lose a total of 125 Objective Life Points

relics.name: Hot Water Kettle
relics.effect: Max Life Point +1, Hope +1
relics.flavor: Some people regularly use the water boiler in the Rhodes Island office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...

relics.name: Special Suppressor
relics.effect: Max Life Point +2, recover 2 Life Points
relics.flavor: An enhanced suppressor developed by Rhodes Island that can better keep the Infected from losing control of their Originium Arts.

relics.name: Stone Gargoyle
relics.effect: Max Life Point +3
relics.flavor: A palm-sized sculpture. Supposedly these are handmade gifts given out by the Gargoyles as a sign of friendship.

relics.name: Vampire's Bed
relics.effect: Max Life Point +4
relics.flavor: A lavish-looking coffin that matches the castle's aesthetics well. However, Warfarin says this is merely a stereotype.

relics.name: Proof of Longevity
relics.effect: Max Life Point +6
relics.flavor:
A tree branch that has withered and flourished.
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Vanguard Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: A formidable set of equipment to provide strength, an indomitable heart to press forward bravely.

relics.name: Bend Spears - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Guard Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Some people use swords because they don't know how to use crossbows or Arts. Others use swords because that's all they need.

relics.name: Iron Guard - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Defender Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Scars symbolize glory, but who will remember the soldiers who were cut a bit too deeply?

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Sniper Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Either you learn to control your fire power, or you learn to discern your target. Got it?'

relics.name: Broken Wand - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Caster Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'After watching the 'performance' of certain casters, I decided to quietly put away the Leithanian textbook.'

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Supporter Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: Their tactics are always diverse and colorful.

relics.name: Healer's Path - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Medic Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: When the day comes when everyone is a doctor and can even cure the disease known as life, we will no longer need doctors.

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Training
relics.effect: Immediately Promote a Specialist Operator (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: When conducting live combat drills with Specialist Operators, please be prepared to be 'beaten up thoroughly before you are prepared.'

relics.name: Acahuallan Bowl
relics.effect: Recover 4 Life Points, Shield +2
relics.flavor: Fruit is one of the locals' staples, often eaten fresh right off the tree.

relics.name: Defender-2
relics.effect: +3 Shield
relics.flavor: A mass-produced defensive drone, oddly effective only in the hands of the enemy.

relics.name: Victorian 'Scrap' Medal
relics.effect: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles
relics.flavor: A knight's medal that Siege threw together and awarded to Dagda on the spot. The materials used are pitiful, but it holds a lot of meaning to Dagda.

relics.name: Bag of Plans
relics.effect: Immediately obtain 3 Plans
relics.flavor: Ideas like 'build a bridge here', 'grow flowers there', or 'blow this wall open' are perfect for sitting inside bags so they can be easily retrieved when needed.

relics.name: Gift of Remembrance
relics.effect: Toil Limit +5
relics.flavor: Water from the Convallis that never loses its shimmer, personally bottled by Laqeramaline Duqa Convalliss days after the miracle. The 'tear-weaving Convallis Hostess' happily gifted these vials to her dear ones.

relics.name: Cursed War Chronicles
relics.effect: Toil Limit +2; Toil Limit +1 after each perfectly cleared battle
relics.flavor: Hidden in the deepest corner of the library, this war chronicle ensnares hapless readers with its countless battles and campaigns, unraveling their minds as they resist. Eventually, the elder revenant tore out the rogue revenant in the book and sealed it in his bones.

relics.name: Lost Key
relics.effect: Gain +20% Command EXP from battles; obtain 50 Originium Ingots upon reaching Command Level 10
relics.flavor: 'Fellas, this key can open the treasure trove lost within the royal city of Kazdel. Hey, green-haired Feline! Watch that hooded slave of yours and keep those hands away from my map!'
relics.unlock: Consolidate 'Rogue Trader' nodes 4 times in Impression Restoration

relics.name: Nameless Totem
relics.effect: Obtain 3 different Thoughts
relics.flavor: This totem once stood at a crossroads, where those who approached would trample the vague outline of a revenant until their feet bled and they died from exhaustion. Eventually, the elder revenant shattered the token with a stomp and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.
relics.unlock: Consolidate 'False to Truth' nodes 2 times in Impression Restoration

relics.name: Revenant Remnant
relics.effect: Hope +2, refresh count at each Node +1
relics.flavor: To be a wandering ghost without a body. This is the price some Sarkaz willingly paid to ensure the future of their race.

relics.name: Magic Box
relics.effect: Originium Ingots +4 and Toil Limit +2
relics.flavor: This ordinary looking box devours souls, compelling those who see it to kill its owner and claim it. When all the humans had killed each other, animals became the new victims. Eventually, the elder revenant retrieved the box from a giant rockhorn's stomach and sealed the rogue revenant in his bones.

relics.name: Half-Eaten Candy
relics.effect: Squad Size Limit +1, Toil Limit +2
relics.flavor: 'With every piece of candy I eat, I feel like I'm losing a part of my body. But I still want to eat more, and more... until that black shadow showed up and ripped away the monster inside me. But that hollow in my mind will never be filled.'

relics.name: Assault Co-op - Sharp Blade
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Vanguard and Guard Operators by +8% for each Vanguard or Guard Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: Use the sharpest spear to strike the hardest shield. I guarantee you that the shield will break first, trust me.

relics.name: Assault Co-op - Skirmish
relics.effect: Increases the DEF of Vanguard and Guard Operators by +10% for each Vanguard or Guard Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: A sophisticated blocking technique is essential to protecting one's body.

relics.name: Fortification Co-op - Phalanx
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Defender and Supporter Operators by +8% for each Defender or Supporter Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: Like a huge ship running over rubble.

relics.name: Fortification Co-op - Resolution
relics.effect: Increases the DEF of Defender and Supporter Operators by +10% for each Defender or Supporter Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: Use the hardest shield to block the sharpest spear. I guarantee you that the spear will break first, trust me.

relics.name: Ranged Co-op - Remote Strike
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Medic and Sniper Operators by +8% for each Medic or Sniper Operator in the combat squad
relics.flavor: If you can solve the problem from a reasonable distance, why do you have to literally butt heads?

relics.name: Ranged Co-op - Assassination
relics.effect: Increases the ASPD of Medic and Sniper Operators by +6 for each Medic or Sniper Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: Can't tell friends from foes at this distance? Unload a volley at them then. The enemies are the ones who failed to avoid it.

relics.name: Sabotage Co-op - Elimination
relics.effect: Increases the ATK of Caster and Specialist Operators by +8% for each Caster or Specialist Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: External destruction, internal disintegration.

relics.name: Sabotage Co-op - Suppression
relics.effect: Increases the ASPD of Caster and Specialist Operators by +6 for each Caster or Specialist Operator in the combat squad.
relics.flavor: Don't worry about accuracy. Take enough shots, and you're guaranteed to land something!

relics.name: Fissured Restraints
relics.effect: All enemy units have -7% ATK
relics.flavor: It seems this sturdy band was once used to restrain something terrifying... Help...

relics.name: Abyssal Wyrdmask
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% ATK
relics.flavor: An eldritch mask not belonging to any culture you're familiar with, capable of making people lose their will to fight... and unconsciously fall into a state of deep contemplation.

relics.name: Godmother's Token
relics.effect: All enemy units have -17% ATK
relics.flavor: A laurel of bones, the token of Signora Sicilia. This symbol of order will smooth the turbulence of all desires, for conflict is not allowed. Genuine or counterfeit, it still demands you to kneel.

relics.name: Worn-out Group Photo
relics.effect: All enemy units have -12% DEF
relics.flavor: Do you know someone in the photo?

relics.name: Sea Terror Jerky
relics.effect: All enemy units have -21% DEF
relics.flavor: When the will to survive outweighs fear, famished Iberians will consume this 'food', only to turn into Sea Terror in one of the days that follow.
relics.unlock: Select 'Gathering Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
relics.effect: All enemy units have -30% DEF
relics.flavor: 'Who will be the judge?'

relics.name: Gold-Plated Die
relics.effect: All enemy units have -15% HP
relics.flavor: The gold-plated die has one side representing life. As for the other nineteen sides...

relics.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -10% HP
relics.flavor: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

relics.name: 'The Silence'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -20% HP
relics.flavor: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

relics.name: Oriron Round Shield
relics.effect: All allied units have +15% DEF
relics.flavor: Before the use of Oriron became widespread in today's industrial sector, the material was frequently used to forge military weapons like this one.

relics.name: Military Mirror Armor
relics.effect: All allied units have +25% DEF
relics.flavor: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.

relics.name: Old Steam Armor
relics.effect: All allied units have +35% DEF
relics.flavor: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.

relics.name: Emperor's Favor
relics.effect: All allied melee units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.

relics.name: Royal Rapier
relics.effect: All allied melee units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: A highly decorative rapier for nobles. Used by Gaulish nobles first and foremost, though perhaps a little fragile for a military weapon.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure

relics.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
relics.effect: All allied melee units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.

relics.name: Necklace of the Presence
relics.effect: All allied ranged units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.

relics.name: Silver Forks
relics.effect: All allied ranged units have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: One for dealing with actors who botch their performances, one for dealing with incompetent playwrights, and one for anyone who needs it. The Chief will not tolerate any mistakes on the table.

relics.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
relics.effect: All allied ranged units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.

relics.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
