relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

zh.name: 精神治疗录像带
zh.effect: 敌人受到的一次性晕眩、寒冷、冻结等异常效果影响时间提高150%
zh.flavor: 这是他曾经多次阻止你听的，他说这很危险，他说你不该逗留——现在你明白了吗？你在听他唱歌。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名辅助干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: 'Hateful Avenger'
relics.effect: All enemies take +35% Physical damage
relics.flavor: A gift from Theresis and set up by Theresa, this is the very first weapon that Ascalon received after her inaugural mission as part of the Military Council.

zh.name: “复仇者”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的物理伤害+35%
zh.flavor: 在阿斯卡纶第一次为军事委员会完成任务后，由特雷西斯亲手赠送，特蕾西娅为她安装的第一把武器。

relics.name: 'Brilliant Lament'
relics.effect: All enemies take +40% Arts damage
relics.flavor: His blood yet flows. He has never left this place.

zh.name: “璀璨悲泣”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的法术伤害+40%
zh.flavor: 他的血液仍在流淌，他从不曾真的自这里离开。

relics.name: Military Mirror Armor
relics.effect: All allied units have +25% DEF
relics.flavor: This mirror armor used to be able to withstand most attacks to the chest, but with the fall of Gaul, such archaic forms of armor have become museum pieces.

zh.name: 军团护心镜
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的防御力+25%
zh.flavor: 这种甲片曾经能够防护住针对心脏的致命伤害，但随着高卢没落，护心镜这种过时的护甲样式也退出了历史舞台。

relics.name: Old Steam Armor
relics.effect: All allied units have +35% DEF
relics.flavor: Even this old, outdated steam armor seems to carry with it the resplendence of when the Victorian monarchs cast their glory across half the world.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with the [Ground Breakthrough Squad]

zh.name: 古旧的蒸汽甲胄
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的防御力+35%
zh.flavor: 哪怕是这种旧型号的蒸汽甲胄，也仿佛承载着维多利亚君主们照耀着半片大地的荣耀辉光。
zh.unlock: 选择【地面突破分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: Emperor's Favor
relics.effect: All allied melee units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: A very sharp letter opener. It was one of the favorite possessions of the last Ursus emperor, and as such it was very rarely used to actually open letters.

zh.name: 皇帝的恩宠
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位的攻击力+15%
zh.flavor: 十分锋利的拆信刀。前任乌萨斯皇帝喜爱的日用品。大多数时候并不用来拆信。

relics.name: Vieux Vanguard's Blade
relics.effect: All allied melee units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: Prior to its downfall, Gaul first witnessed the sacrifices of its Vieux Vanguards.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Assault Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 老近卫军之锋
zh.effect: 所有我方近战单位的攻击力+35%
zh.flavor: 高卢将见证老近卫军的牺牲，随后才迎来自己的覆灭。
zh.unlock: 选择【突击战术分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: Necklace of the Presence
relics.effect: All allied ranged units have +15% ATK
relics.flavor: Faith hangs ten centimeters above your heart, spoken words flow into your blood, and bullets slide into your magazine.

zh.name: 显圣吊坠
zh.effect: 所有我方远程单位的攻击力+15%
zh.flavor: 信仰悬在你的心口上方十公分处，语言流入你的血液，子弹滑进你的弹仓。

relics.name: Damaged Revolver Cylinder
relics.effect: All allied ranged units have +35% ATK
relics.flavor: She never capitulated, even after enduring countless trials and tribulations. Her muzzle belched tongues of flame that burned like an angry sun, and the glow above her head was brighter than the daylight itself. Buried here is Outcast, our friend.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with the [High Ground Breakthrough Squad]

zh.name: 损坏的左轮弹巢
zh.effect: 所有我方远程单位的攻击力+35%
zh.flavor: 她行过刀山火海也不曾有一刻向奸邪低头，她枪口火舌焦灼好似怒阳，她头顶光芒炽烈几胜白昼。此处安葬着Outcast，我们的朋友。
zh.unlock: 选择【高台突破分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: Gravity Defying Machine
relics.effect: All enemies have -2 Weight
relics.flavor: Nasti Lunorey's magnum opus lifted the Sarkaz from the land that had tormented them for thousands of years. Now, though they float in ethereal clouds, they remain firmly rooted in the sky.

zh.name: 重力蔑视机关
zh.effect: 所有敌人重量-2
zh.flavor: 娜斯提·鲁诺瑞伊的杰作将萨卡兹托离了残害他们千万年的大地，此后，萨卡兹虽缥缈于云端，却将自己的根系，牢牢扎在了天空之上。

relics.name: Lakebed Aegis
relics.effect: Shield +1; all allied units gain Max HP +60% if you have any Shield at the start of a battle
relics.flavor: Three decades ago, a child dropped his toy wooden shield into the lake. Three decades later, he bores through the frozen lake, retrieves his shield, and embarks on a hero's journey.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, enter non-combat nodes in the Garden a total of 40 times

zh.name: 湖中神盾
zh.effect: 护盾值+1；战斗开始时如果拥有护盾值，所有我方单位的最大生命+60%
zh.flavor: 三十年前，孩童的玩具木盾落入湖中。三十年后，他凿开冰封湖泊，取出盾牌，踏上英雄的旅途。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计进入40次界园非战斗节点

relics.name: Spinach Pack
relics.effect: Operators have +60% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: Many Cautus out there believe that popping the contents of this can into their mouths will grant them immense strength. The marketing's effectiveness is a classic success story in the industry.

zh.name: 绿叶菜罐头
zh.effect: 所有干员技能触发后1秒内攻击力+60%
zh.flavor: 很多卡特斯相信吃下这盒罐头，他们就会变得力大无穷。出色的广告效果，业界经典成功案例。

relics.name: Wrath of Siracusans
relics.effect: Operators have +100% ATK for one second after their skill becomes active
relics.flavor: The signature pasta dish of an 'authentic Siracusan restaurant' that once operated in the capital of Gaul. The dish's unique taste, and particularly its sauce—a blend of thick chocolate sauce and Originium Slug liver—earned the praise of many Gaulish nobles. Supposedly, though, this dish nearly caused a diplomatic crisis between Siracusa and Gaul.
relics.unlock: Win the battle [Endless Stream] while losing no more than 3 Life Points

zh.name: 叙拉古人的愤怒
zh.effect: 所有干员技能触发后1秒内攻击力+100%
zh.flavor: 曾经开设在高卢首都的一家“正宗叙拉古餐厅”的招牌面食，用浓郁的巧克力酱与源石虫肝制成的酱汁以其独特风味备受高卢贵族好评。但是据说差一点引起叙拉古与高卢的外交冲突。
zh.unlock: 在损失不超过3点目标生命的情况下胜利战斗【源源不断】

relics.name: Castle's Offspring
relics.effect: All Operators gain +400 DEF and +30 RES after staying on the field for 80 seconds
relics.flavor: With enough time, this box will become a whole new stage.

zh.name: 古堡的子嗣
zh.effect: 所有干员在场上停留80秒后防御力+400，法术抗性+30
zh.flavor: 只要有足够时间，这个盒子便能成为另一座崭新的舞台。

relics.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips
relics.effect: Summons have +30% HP, +30% ATK, and will no longer use Deployment slots
relics.flavor: 'Drunk far beyond all mounts that list the realm, all beings take on souls as they demand.'

zh.name: 散轶诗简
zh.effect: 【召唤物】的生命值+30%、攻击力+30%，并且不再消耗部署位
zh.flavor: “酣然失千山，万物得其灵。”

relics.name: Frozen Husk
relics.effect: Melee Operators gain ASPD +40 for 5 seconds after taking damage
relics.flavor: The warriors of Sami stationed in the Fjal Vetrtonn are often inspired by an illusion: As their life flows toward the earth, their originally frozen bodies become lighter and lighter.

zh.name: 冰结的躯壳
zh.effect: 近战干员在受到伤害后5秒内，攻击速度+40
zh.flavor: 驻守在冬牙群山的萨米战士经常被一种幻觉鼓舞：随着生命流向大地，他们原本被冻僵的身体变得越来越轻快。

relics.name: Ancient Fresco
relics.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 1000 Arts damage and are Silenced for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: Walk out of the cave, and raise your head. This has never been right, even since antiquity.

zh.name: 古老壁画
zh.effect: 敌人进入和解除浮空、失重状态时，受到1000点法术伤害，并在10秒内失去特殊能力
zh.flavor: 走出洞窟，抬头看看吧，自古以来，也不尽然。

relics.name: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
relics.effect: When an enemy enters or is freed from Levitation and/or Weightless, they take 2000 Arts damage and take 30% more damage for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: At that moment, the light of truth shone onto the earth.

zh.name: 万星园之辉
zh.effect: 敌人进入和解除浮空、失重状态时，受到2000点法术伤害，并在10秒内受到的伤害+30%
zh.flavor: 在那一瞬，真实之光普照大地。

relics.name: Ring of Thorns
relics.effect: When Melee Operators are healed, they and Operators in the adjacent 4 tiles will recover 1 SP
relics.flavor: You were able to steady yourself while in a distorted fear. There is blood left on the thorns, and you don't know if it was you or the Snowpriest who was pricked by them. They will use whatever means they have, without batting an eye.

zh.name: 荆棘环
zh.effect: 近战干员在受到治疗后，使自身和周围4格内的干员获得1点技力
zh.flavor: 你得以从扭曲的恐惧中稳定自我。荆棘上残留着血渍，不知道是刺伤了你还是雪祀自己。他们使用任何手段时都不会眨一下眼睛。

relics.name: Frost Buck's Pauldron
relics.effect: All allied units gain ATK +40% and DEF +40% for 30 seconds when blocking 2 or more enemies
relics.flavor: There are no signs of injuries on his body, only a pair of eyes drained of blood and tears.
relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

zh.name: 霜牡的肩甲
zh.effect: 所有我方单位阻挡2名及以上敌人后，攻击力+40%，防御力+40%，持续30秒
zh.flavor: 他的遗体上见不到伤痕，只有一双眼睛流干了血泪。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名重装干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: Vinecreep Mortar Gunner
relics.effect: When an aerial enemy is defeated, deals 5000 Physical Damage to other nearby enemies
relics.flavor: It's no surprise such a fantastical weapon would appear when people from different cultures let down their guard and communicate with sincerity.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Ranged Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 藤蔓炮手
zh.effect: 敌方空中单位被击败后，对周围其他敌人造成5000点物理伤害
zh.flavor: 当不同文化的人放下戒备真心交流，出现这样带有奇思妙想的武器也就不足为奇了。
zh.unlock: 选择【远程战术分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: 'Devotion'
relics.effect: When ranged Operators attack or heal, deal 300 Arts Damage to a random enemy within their attack range
relics.flavor: Since antiquity, this tribe has believed that they hold a truth about Sami: Everything originally had a voice, until 'It' spoke for all of them.

zh.name: “奉献”
zh.effect: 远程干员攻击或治疗时，对攻击范围内一名随机敌人造成300点法术伤害
zh.flavor: 自远古以来，这一部族笃信自己掌握着有关萨米的真相：原本万物各有声音，直到“祂”代替万物言语。

relics.name: 'Blossom'
relics.effect: All Operators recover 1 SP every time they take damage or Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: After several attempts by Touch, nature briefly opens up to you.

zh.name: “绽放”
zh.effect: 所有干员每次受到伤害时回复1点技力，每次受到元素损伤时回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 在Touch的尝试下，自然暂时向你敞开心扉。

relics.name: Royal Brooch
relics.effect: All friendly units have +15 RES, and dodge one instance of damage after deployment
relics.flavor: An ornament worn by Gaulish royalty, made from gold and inlaid with expensive Originium crystals. They are more than decoration: many of these brooches hide Originium circuits loaded with defensive Arts.

zh.name: 皇族金胸针
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的法术抗性+15，且部署后抵挡一次伤害
zh.flavor: 高卢皇族用于彰显身份的装饰品，由黄金打造，镶嵌了大量昂贵的固化源石结晶。实际上这种胸针不单纯是装饰，许多胸针安装了搭载防御性法术的通用源石回路。

relics.name: String Puppet
relics.effect: Enemies receive 700 Arts damage per second when stunned, frozen, or bound
relics.flavor: The more you struggle and try to break free, the tighter the strings get. Do you really think you are still thinking rationally?

zh.name: 悬丝傀儡
zh.effect: 敌人被晕眩、冻结、束缚时，每秒受到700点法术伤害
zh.flavor: 越是用力想要挣脱，丝线就缠得越紧。你真的认为自己仍在思考？

relics.name: 'Children's Puppet'
relics.effect: Enemies receive 1400 Arts Damage per second while Stunned, Frozen, or Bound
relics.flavor: A simple puppet made by Iberian children using trinkets found on the seacoast. Supposedly just holding it tight will give you much richer dreams.

zh.name: “童趣玩偶”
zh.effect: 敌人被晕眩、冻结、束缚时，每秒受到1400点法术伤害
zh.flavor: 伊比利亚的孩童们将海岸边的奇物做成了简陋玩偶，听说只要抱着它，梦乡就会变得充实起来。

relics.name: Bank of Gaul Check
relics.effect: All Operators start with +12 SP
relics.flavor: An extravagant checkbook plated in gold and silver. Can no longer be cashed.

zh.name: 高卢银行支票
zh.effect: 所有干员的初始技力+12
zh.flavor: 镶金嵌银、奢华无比的支票本，现在已经无从兑现。

relics.name: Worn-out Group Photo
relics.effect: All enemy units have -4% Max HP and -8% DEF
relics.flavor: Do you know someone in the photo?

zh.name: 残破合影
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-4%，防御力-8%
zh.flavor: 里面有你认识的人吗？

relics.name: Rosmontis's Embrace
relics.effect: All enemy units have -10% Max HP and -20% DEF
relics.flavor: 'Who will be the judge?'

zh.name: 迷迭香之拥
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-10%，防御力-20%
zh.flavor: “谁来审判？”

relics.name: 'The Whisperer in Darknight'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -10% HP
relics.flavor: A black vinyl. DO. NOT. TOUCH. IT.

zh.name: “黑夜呢喃”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-10%
zh.flavor: 一张黑色唱片。不。准。碰。它。

relics.name: 'The Silence'
relics.effect: All enemy units have -20% HP
relics.flavor: A painting that depicts the greatest disaster in Iberian history. Its brushstrokes, colors, and images are all meaningless. 'The Ægir know. The Ægir know. The Ægir know.'

zh.name: 《大静谧》
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命-20%
zh.flavor: 描绘伊比利亚史上最大灾难的画作，笔触毫无意义，色彩毫无意义，意象毫无意义。“阿戈尔知道，阿戈尔知道，阿戈尔知道。”

relics.name: Noxious Hemostatic Agent
relics.effect: All allied units gain +20% Max HP; [Candle Attendants] gain an additional +10%
relics.flavor: 'After fermentation, the body fluids of this Originium slug can be used to stop bleeding.' —'Rhodes Island Wilderness Survival Guide'

zh.name: 难闻的止血剂
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的生命+20%，【伺烛客】额外+10%
zh.flavor: “这种源石虫的体液经过发酵处理之后可以用于止血”——《罗德岛野外生存指南》

relics.name: Unknown Instrument
relics.effect: All allied units gain +50% Max HP; [Candle Attendants] gain an additional +30%
relics.flavor: Don't ask. It's for your own good.

zh.name: 未知仪器
zh.effect: 所有我方单位的生命+50%，【伺烛客】额外+30%
zh.flavor: 不要问。就当为了你自己好。

relics.name: Live Rose
relics.effect: All allied units have +20% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: Is it you who nourishes her, or is it her who protects you?

zh.name: 活玫瑰
zh.effect: 所有我方单位受到的治疗和生命回复效果+20%
zh.flavor: 是你滋养她，还是她守护你？

relics.name: White Flower Crown
relics.effect: All allied units have +30% healing effectiveness
relics.flavor: A floral veil used in Vampire rituals. Its once vibrant redness has been sucked empty, leaving only a pale white color.

zh.name: 苍白花冠
zh.effect: 所有我方单位受到的治疗和生命回复效果+30%
zh.flavor: 血魔仪式使用的花冠头纱，曾经鲜红的生命被吮吸殆尽，现在只余苍白。

relics.name: Captain Morgan's Wine
relics.effect: Starting SP +5; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 3 seconds
relics.flavor: A wine produced in the Iberian region. Despite having gained popularity in the heart of Victoria's bustling cities, it is now discontinued.

zh.name: 摩根队长佳酿
zh.effect: 初始技力+5，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每3秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 一种产自伊比利亚地区的酒，在维多利亚中部城市大受欢迎，现已停产。

relics.name: Water of Life
relics.effect: Starting SP +7; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 2.5 seconds
relics.flavor: The strongest Ursus liquors go straight to one's head, but it's said that the healthy Ursusian adult can down several bottles.
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Fortification Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 生命之水
zh.effect: 初始技力+7，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每2.5秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 度数奇高的乌萨斯烈酒，上头，据说一个健康的乌萨斯人能干掉好几瓶。
zh.unlock: 选择【堡垒战术分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: Royal Liqueur
relics.effect: Starting SP +7; all Offensive and Defensive Recovery skills recover 1 SP every 1.5 seconds
relics.flavor: The fine wines of the fallen nation of Gaul have now become prized treasures for collectors. The place of production has moved to Leithanien, but the technique has been lost.

zh.name: 皇家利口酒
zh.effect: 初始技力+7，所有攻击和受击回复的技能每1.5秒回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 已灭亡国家“高卢”的好酒，现在成为了收藏家手中的珍惜奇货，价格不菲。产地现处莱塔尼亚境内，工艺则已经失传。

relics.name: 'Numbness and Obscenity'
relics.effect: All allied units gain +5 RES and +10% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: A famous art piece and the final piece created by an insane Leithanian sculptor two hundred years ago. The sculptor was known for his extraordinary talent and his participation in multiple cruel homicides. However, historical records show that few people took notice of his work. He was instead known for his features and beauty.

zh.name: 《麻木与庸俗》
zh.effect: 所有我方单位法术抗性+5，法术闪避+10%
zh.flavor: 一件著名的艺术品，两百年前莱塔尼亚疯狂雕塑家的遗作。这位雕塑家以才华横溢与参与多起残忍的命案而为人所知。但是依据历史记载，他生前并没有多少人关注他的作品，而是因为自己秀美的长相而被人追捧。

relics.name: Designer's Ruler
relics.effect: All allied units gain 15% Physical Dodge, and +30% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: Carefully measured with data and experience, those who wear this armor are known to be several magnitudes luckier.

zh.name: 设计师量尺
zh.effect: 所有我方单位获得15%物理闪避，且触发闪避后6秒内攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 在数据、经验以及精确测量下，身着铠甲的人多了几分幸运。

relics.name: 'Arts Killer'
relics.effect: All allied units gain 15% Arts Dodge, and +30% ATK for 6 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: Considering how Originium Arts and music go hand in hand in Leithanien, it's quite amazing someone came up with the bright idea of combating Arts with noise like this.

zh.name: “法术杀手”
zh.effect: 所有我方单位获得15%法术闪避，且触发闪避后6秒内攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 由于莱塔尼亚人的源石技艺与音乐息息相关，有人竟想出了用噪音对抗法术的蠢主意。

relics.name: 'Glorious Kazimierz'
relics.effect: Operators gain +70 ASPD for 15 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: A Kazimierzian best-seller that adapts the deeds of the arena's brightest-shining knights into a novel. Nearl, who was exiled but returned to reclaim her laurels, occupies a considerable portion of its pages.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 40 battles

zh.name: 《光耀卡西米尔》
zh.effect: 干员触发闪避后15秒内攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 卡西米尔畅销书，以小说笔调讲述了自有骑士竞技以来那些闪耀竞技场的骑士事迹。惨遭放逐但重夺桂冠的临光占据了相当大的篇幅。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利40场战斗

relics.name: 'The Return'
relics.effect: Operators gain +130% ATK for 15 seconds after dodging
relics.flavor: This Kazimierzian best-seller is said to be a collective creation by fans. 'Nearl' has already become an amalgamation of many ideals and fantasies. 'For her, exile was not an escape. She came back, and stood alone against the era's torrents.'

zh.name: 《归来》
zh.effect: 干员触发闪避后15秒内攻击力+130%
zh.flavor: 卡西米尔畅销书，据说是粉丝的集体创作，“临光”已然成为糅杂了诸多幻想的形象复合体。“放逐，并非逃避。她归来，独自抵挡时代的洪流。”

relics.name: Celestial Dust
relics.effect: When a ranged Operator manually activates a skill, all enemies within their attack range are Levitated for 5 seconds
relics.flavor: She gently blows away the countless records of sunrises, moonsets, and the changing of the stars. Her life is blown away that easily.

zh.name: 天穹尘埃
zh.effect: 远程干员在手动开启技能时，使攻击范围内的所有敌人浮空5秒
zh.flavor: 她轻轻吹动无数次日升月落、星辰更替的记录。她的生命轻易就被吹走。

relics.name: 'Blademace'
relics.effect: All Operators have +3 DP Cost, but gain +20% ATK, DEF, and Max HP
relics.flavor: A sword lodged in a stone. Was someone bored enough to do this?

zh.name: “剑锤”
zh.effect: 所有干员的部署费用+3，但攻击力、防御力和生命+20%
zh.flavor: 插在巨大石头上的剑，到底是谁这么无聊啊。

relics.name: Writ of Investiture
relics.effect: Operators deployed within the 8 tiles around an Incursion Point gain +100% ATK
relics.flavor: A conscription writ from the Age of the Great Hunt, held in a museum. It called for a band able to venture deep into the lairs of colossal beasts; attached behind it is a pledge of life and death, filled with signatures.

zh.name: 封神令
zh.effect: 干员部署在侵入点周围8格时，攻击力+100%
zh.flavor: 博物馆收藏的大狩猎时代的征兵令。此令征集一支有能力深入巨兽巢穴的队伍，附在它后面的是签满了名字的生死状。

relics.name: Chang-Binding Cord
relics.effect: [Summons] have -5 DP Cost, -25% Redeployment Time, and +30% ATK
relics.flavor: The marking and restraining cord worn by Chang spirits enlisted by the Sui Office while they work. Teapots that pour themselves, watering cans that diligently tend the flowers: they excel at simple, repetitive work.

zh.name: 束伥索
zh.effect: 【召唤物】的部署费用-5，再部署时间-25%，攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 被司岁台收编的伥怪在做活时所戴的标记、约束之索。主动倒水的茶壶、努力浇花的花洒，它们十分擅长简单重复的工作。

relics.name: "A-Meng"
relics.effect: All enemy units take +100% Elemental Damage
relics.flavor: During the calamity of Sui's awakening a century ago, the Sui Office relied on specially trained tracker beasts to search out and destroy Chang spirits. This clay figure was made in memory of the beasts that fell.

zh.name: “阿猛”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的元素伤害+100%
zh.flavor: 百年前岁兽苏醒的灾祸中，司岁台曾借助经特殊训练的循兽，对伥怪进行全方位的搜索及消灭。此陶制品为纪念当时牺牲的循兽而制。

relics.name: Rewarder of Virtue
relics.effect: After an allied unit dodges or blocks a hit, its next attack deals +100% damage
relics.flavor: An examination aid built by apprentices of the Tianshi Academy. Answer correctly and you get nothing. Answer wrongly... best not to try.

zh.name: 赏善郎
zh.effect: 我方单位触发闪避或抵挡后，下次攻击造成的伤害+100%
zh.flavor: 天师府学徒自主研制的考校辅助器。答对问题时什么也得不到。答错时......还是别尝试了吧。

relics.name: Realm in the Mirror
relics.effect: The first damage dealt by each enemy is reduced by 90%
relics.flavor: Mirrors that hang above the doors and windows of the Garden. When visitors meet sudden danger, the realm within the mirror becomes their emergency shelter, until the mirror shatters.

zh.name: 镜中境
zh.effect: 敌人首次造成的伤害-90%
zh.flavor: 常悬于界园门窗之上的镜子。当游客遇到突如其来的危机，镜中之境便是他们的紧急避难所——直至镜子碎裂。

relics.name: Everburning Lamp Wick
relics.effect: The first ground Operator deployed gains +50% ATK, Resistance, and 50% Elemental Injury reduction until defeated or retreated
relics.flavor: Those who ascend for the first time carry a lit candle, lest their minds drown in Sui's consciousness. Darkness closes in, but the flame burns on, anchoring their way back through the long night. This is where the name "Candlebearer" comes from.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 80 Operators deployed in battle

zh.name: 长明灯引
zh.effect: 第一名部署的地面干员攻击力+50%、并获得抵抗、50%元素损伤减免，持续至被击倒或撤离
zh.flavor: 首次登升之人，为保其心智不被岁识淹没，持燃烛在手。瞢暗迫近，而烛火长明，为其在长夜中锚定意识归来之路。“秉烛”之名亦从中而来。
zh.unlock: 累计在战斗中部署干员不小于80次的情况下完成游戏结局

relics.name: "Fireflies on the Page"
relics.effect: When an enemy unit is defeated, nearby allied units restore 300 HP
relics.flavor: By the schoolhouse window, a potted plant from home was withering, but the scholar could not bear to throw it away. One day the grass in the pot was gone, and fireflies circled the pot instead, lighting the pages for him.

zh.name: “萤灯映牍”
zh.effect: 敌方单位被击倒时，使周围的我方单位回复300点生命值
zh.flavor: 校舍窗边，家乡盆景渐枯，而书生不忍丢弃。终有一日，盆中草不见踪影，而盆上萤火萦绕，替他照亮了书页。

relics.name: Toy Slingshot
relics.effect: When an Operator activates a skill, deal Arts Damage equal to 30% of their ATK to all enemies within attack range
relics.flavor: A bronze slingshot born from the great furnace. Pull back the band and a little bronze figure curls up into an astonishingly heavy pellet, ready to fire. "Here, go play. Dangerous? Nonsense, it's just a toy."

zh.name: 玩具弹弓
zh.effect: 干员释放技能时对攻击范围内的所有敌人造成相当于攻击力30%的法术伤害
zh.flavor: 从洪炉中诞生的青铜弹弓，拉开皮筋时，小铜人会蜷成一团沉得惊人的弹丸，以待发射。“喏，拿去玩。危险个锤子，就是个玩具嘛。”

relics.name: Snack Basket
relics.effect: At the start of battle, all Operators' natural SP recovery is +100%; the effect ends when any Operator manually activates a skill
relics.flavor: A basket full of snacks sold outside the gardens, confiscated at the entrance check. The staff, looking grim, asked where it came from. When you told them the truth, they reassured you it was fine, then immediately grabbed suspicious-looking tools and ran off in the direction you'd pointed.

zh.name: 零嘴背篓
zh.effect: 战斗开始时所有干员自然回复技力的速度+100%，任意干员手动释放技能时失效
zh.flavor: 园林外贩卖的，装满零嘴的背篓，却在入园检查时被扣押。工作人员脸色难看地询问这东西从何而来，你如实回答后，他们一边安慰你没事，一边立刻抄起形状可疑的工具向你说的方向奔去。

relics.name: Lingering Spring
relics.effect: When an enemy is defeated, all enemies around it are inflicted with Cold for 6 seconds
relics.flavor: An immortal of the He family passed by, and left a sprig of spring as a gift.

zh.name: 留春
zh.effect: 敌人被击倒时，使其周围所有敌人获得6秒的寒冷
zh.flavor: 何家仙人过，聊赠一枝春。

relics.name: Eye in the Wall
relics.effect: Allied Operators take 50% less Physical and Arts Damage from sources outside their own attack range
relics.flavor: Its consciousness already exists. Its steps are trapped within the wall. It shields you from wind and woe. It watches you as you leave.

zh.name: 墙眼
zh.effect: 我方干员受到来自自身攻击范围以外的物理与法术伤害降低50%
zh.flavor: 它的意识已然存在。它的步伐困于墙中。它为你遮风挡灾。它注视你的远去。

relics.name: Chuanfang Printing Block
relics.effect: After an Operator activates an ammo-based skill, gain +2% ATK each time they deal damage (stacks up to 30 times)
relics.flavor: A jujube-wood printing block for a popular poetry collection. When proud literati saw such vulgar verse spread far and wide, they would sneer: "Hmph. Poor jujube tree, it did nothing to deserve this."

zh.name: 传芳雕版
zh.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能后，每次造成伤害时，攻击力+2%（最多叠加30层）
zh.flavor: 流行诗集的枣木雕版。见到自己眼中欠佳的俗诗雕版广为流传时，清高文人往往嗤之以鼻：“哼，可悲枣树，罪不至此。”

relics.name: Three Feet of Myriad Forms
relics.effect: When an Operator activates an ammo-based skill, gain +100 ASPD for 15 seconds
relics.flavor: A movable-type press from an ancient Yan print shop. The gentleman wields words as weapons, while the petty... Once, before a print run, a shop found the character for "not" had been stolen, and a rebuttal suddenly meant the opposite, to everyone's mixed amusement.

zh.name: 三尺万象
zh.effect: 干员开启弹药类技能时，攻击速度+100，持续15秒
zh.flavor: 古时炎国印书坊所用活字印刷机。君子以字为利器，而小人......曾有印书坊下印前，发现“非”字被偷，驳斥之文意思骤变，令人啼笑皆非。

relics.name: "Yan Lexicon"
relics.effect: Each time an ammo-based skill is activated, the first time ammo drops to 30%, replenish ammo equal to 30% of the maximum
relics.flavor: Yan's first general dictionary, completed by a commoner author over ten years. The compiler often lamented that the book was thin and the characters many, and raised a tomb for the rare characters he could not include, destined to be lost.

zh.name: 《炎国字汇》
zh.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量30%的弹药
zh.flavor: 炎国的第一本通用字典，由民间作者历经十年完成。编者常叹书薄而字多，为无法收录、注定失传的生僻字立有一方字冢。

relics.name: "Elegant Gathering"
relics.effect: Each time an ammo-based skill is activated, the first time ammo drops to 30%, replenish ammo equal to 50% of the maximum
relics.flavor: Yan's first poetry anthology, collecting the most widely sung poems of its day. Its popularity sparked such a craze for copying and writing poems that paper and ink were in short supply that year.

zh.name: 《雅集》
zh.effect: 弹药类技能每次开启后，首次剩余30%的弹药时，补充最大弹药数量50%的弹药
zh.flavor: 炎国的第一部诗集，收录了当年传唱最广的诗篇。因其广受欢迎，促使民间抄诗与写诗的热情剧增，一度导致当年的纸墨供不应求。

relics.name: Weave of Thorns and Leaves
relics.effect: Designates 1 random deployable Realm Tile at the start of each battle; after an Operator is deployed there, allied units within the surrounding 8 tiles gain Camouflage
relics.flavor: Those within this ring receive the favor of the thorns and leaves.

zh.name: 荆与叶的织带
zh.effect: 每次战斗会从化境地块里随机1个可部署位置，该位置部署干员后，周围8格内的我方单位具有迷彩
zh.flavor: 于此环中，得受荆棘草叶之偏爱。

relics.name: Weave of Snow and Soil
relics.effect: Designates 1 random deployable Realm Tile at the start of each battle; when the Operator on that tile activates an Offensive or Defensive Recovery skill, all Operators on Realm Tiles recover 1 SP
relics.flavor: Those within this ring receive the attention of the snow and earth.

zh.name: 雪与土的织带
zh.effect: 每次战斗会在化境地块里随机1个可部署位置，该位置的我方干员开启攻击回复或受击回复技能时，使化境地块上的所有干员同时回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 于此环中，得受霜雪大地之青睐。

relics.name: Distant Home's Guide
relics.effect: Designates 1 random deployable Realm Tile at the start of each battle; allied units on that tile recover 1 SP and 3% of their Max HP per second
relics.flavor: This ancient ring is actually said to be a special navigation device, used to find emergency supplies that the Ægir once secretly stashed in various spots across the ocean. Follow the ocean's currents, be guided by wind; your homeland will always continue to bestow gifts upon you.

zh.name: 遥乡之引
zh.effect: 每次战斗会在化境地块里随机1个可部署位置，该位置上的我方单位每秒回复1点技力和自身3%的血量
zh.flavor: 一枚古拙的戒指，实为特制的导航设备，凭借它可以找到阿戈尔曾在海洋各处秘密存储的应急物资。跟随洋流，跟随风，故乡将永远给予你馈赠。

relics.name: "Broken Jade"
relics.effect: Operators deployed on Realm Tiles do not retreat the first time they are defeated, and restore 30% HP instead
relics.flavor: A jade pendant gifted by the master of the Garden. You met a fine companion in the Garden and traveled together; when you declined his invitation to go elsewhere, his face suddenly changed. He seized you, then snatched his hand back as if burned and fled. Relieved, you found a piece of the pendant at your waist had cracked away.

zh.name: “成玦”
zh.effect: 部署在化境地块上干员，首次被击倒时不撤退且回复30%生命
zh.flavor: 界园主人所赠玉佩。园中偶遇良友，一路同行，欲邀你去他处游玩，婉拒后其人嘴脸骤变，强行拉扯你后却如遭烫般缩手逃开。你松口气，发现腰间玉佩已裂了一块。

relics.name: Old Sandals
relics.effect: Summons deployed on Realm Tiles take -50% Physical and Arts Damage and gain +50% ATK
relics.flavor: Old straw sandals found under a bridge. An old man on the bridge waited for you to return them, but once you climbed up, you saw only the other sandal. Thinking back, the old man's face seemed to appear in certain ancient paintings...

zh.name: 故履
zh.effect: 部署在化境地块上的召唤物，受到的物理法术伤害-50%，攻击力+50%
zh.flavor: 桥下拾到的旧草鞋。桥上老者等着你将鞋归还，待上桥，却只看到另一只鞋。仔细想来，老者的面容似在某些古画中出现过......

relics.name: Yi's Lock
relics.effect: Randomly selects 2 deployable Realm Tiles; gain 8 DP each time an Operator is deployed on them (can be upgraded at Lost and Found)
relics.flavor: One of Yi's inventions, from which Ji profited handsomely. Both ornament and puzzle; if you can work out its secret, perhaps you will understand "Sui" a little better.

zh.name: 易锁
zh.effect: 在化境地块上随机选择2个可部署位置，每次在该位置部署干员时，获得8点部署费用（在失与得中可以升级）
zh.flavor: 易的发明之一，绩用此牟利颇多。既是摆件，又是益智玩具，若能弄清其中奥秘，或许对“岁”的理解能更多一分。

relics.name: Twisted Yi's Lock
relics.effect: Randomly selects 5 deployable Realm Tiles; gain 10 DP each time an Operator is deployed on them
relics.flavor: Yi's Lock, reworked by its inventor. The structure is more complex, and its nesting no longer seems to follow any logic. Yet if you can grasp its secret, your understanding of "Sui" may go one step further.

zh.name: 错易锁
zh.effect: 在化境地块上随机选择5个可部署位置，每次在该位置部署干员时，获得10点部署费用
zh.flavor: 经发明者本人改造后的易锁。结构更复杂，嵌套之法似乎变得不循常理。然而，若是能了悟其中的奥秘，或许对“岁”的理解就能更进一步。

relics.name: Mother Cauldron
relics.effect: All Operators deployed on Realm Tiles gain +10% ATK (may be upgraded at Everjoy, up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: The Nine Provinces and all their lands are represented by the Nine Cauldrons. As for how those cauldrons were cast... "Born from the Mother Cauldron, of course!" a certain film maestro said with a laugh.

zh.name: 母鼎
zh.effect: 使所有部署在化境地块上的干员，攻击力+10%（在常乐中有机会升级，上限10次）
zh.flavor: 九州万方，自用九鼎以代之。至于这些鼎是怎么铸造的......“当然是母鼎生的啊！”某位电影大师笑着说道。

relics.name: Tender Bamboo
relics.effect: All Operators deployed on Realm Tiles gain +10% Max HP (may be upgraded at Everjoy, up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: New bamboo grown in Shu's treasured fields: fruit without cause, cycling endlessly. With each cycle it grows one more segment, until it has ten, and its end meets its beginning.

zh.name: 嫰竹
zh.effect: 使所有部署在化境地块上的干员，生命值+10%（在常乐中有机会升级，上限10次）
zh.flavor: 从黍的宝田中种出的新竹，有果无因，循环往复，每循一遭便多一节，直至长出十节，首尾相连。

relics.name: "Introduction to Go: Openings"
relics.effect: After battle starts, randomly select 3 deployable ground Realm Tiles and deploy a "Disrepaired Stage Fog Machine" on each
relics.flavor: Between square and circle, what move is this? The clack of stones stops; how exhilarating. When the game ends... the times have changed.

zh.name: 《围棋入门布局篇》
zh.effect: 战斗开始后，随机选择3个可部署的地面化境地块，部署“失修舞台雾机”
zh.flavor: 方圆之间，此着为何？棋枰响止，酣畅淋漓。一局终了......时移世易。

relics.name: Flying Brocade War Banner
relics.effect: When an Operator on a Realm Tile activates a skill, all Operators on other Realm Tiles recover 1 SP
relics.flavor: Legend says it was wielded by the true dragon who ended the Hundred Clans' Strife; one wave of the banner and a hundred generals followed... The strength never lay in the banner, but in the shared will to halt war and bring peace under heaven.

zh.name: 飞锦战旌
zh.effect: 化境地块里的干员释放技能时，给其他所有化境地块里的干员回复1点技力
zh.flavor: 传说，曾为结束百氏之乱的那位真龙所用，战旗一挥，百将跟随......强大的从来不是旗帜，而是众人遏战乱、平天下之心。

relics.name: Jujube Mask
relics.effect: All Operators take 50% less damage from units they are blocking, and deal 50% more damage to enemies they are blocking
relics.flavor: The opera mask of an ancient hero of Great Yan. Records say he was loyal without wavering, and to protect his sworn brothers rode alone a thousand miles, overcoming an army of thousands.

zh.name: 枣面
zh.effect: 所有干员受到来自自身阻挡单位的伤害降低50％，对被自身阻挡的敌人造成的伤害提高50%
zh.flavor: 一位古代大炎英雄的脸谱。有记载称其忠心不二，为保结义金兰，千里一骑力克千军。

relics.name: Elder's Mask
relics.effect: Every second, all Operators deal Arts Damage equal to 150% of their ATK to enemies they are blocking and reduce the target's accuracy by 15%
relics.flavor: The opera mask of a hero of high antiquity in Great Yan, the origin of the word "Tianshi". Legend says he was learned and wise, and vanished after securing a thousand years of peace for the Yan.

zh.name: 老者面
zh.effect: 所有干员每秒对自身阻挡的敌人造成攻击力150%的法术伤害并减低目标15%的命中率
zh.flavor: 一位上古大炎英雄的脸谱。天师一词的源流，传说其博学多闻，为炎氏谋千载太平后消失无踪。

relics.name: Charcoal Mask
relics.effect: Enemies are inflicted with Fear for 5 seconds the first time they are blocked
relics.flavor: The opera mask of an ancient hero of Great Yan. Records say he was bold yet meticulous, and his shout could split rivers.

zh.name: 炭面
zh.effect: 敌人首次被阻挡时，恐惧5秒
zh.flavor: 一位古代大炎英雄的脸谱。有记载称其胆大心细，喝声可断江河。

relics.name: Moon Maiden Mask
relics.effect: For each enemy an Operator blocks, they gain 10% Physical and Arts Dodge (stacks up to 5 times)
relics.flavor: The opera mask of a legendary figure of Great Yan. The tale of her tears flowing into a river as she searched for her husband, and of her flight to chase the moon, is still told today.

zh.name: 月女面
zh.effect: 干员每阻挡一名敌人，获得10%物理与法术闪避，最多叠加5层
zh.flavor: 一位传说中的大炎人物的脸谱。其为寻夫泪洒成河飞身逐月的故事流传至今。

relics.name: Broken Wand - Undulation
relics.effect: For every Caster Operator on the field, all allied units deal +12% Arts damage (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Tuned to the same frequency; together we'll play the melody.

zh.name: 断杖-波纹
zh.effect: 场上每有一名术师干员，所有敌人受到的法术伤害+12%（最多叠加8层）
zh.flavor: 调谐到同一频率，让我们奏起旋律。

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Predation
relics.effect: For every Vanguard Operator on the field, gain 1 DP every 3 seconds (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: The pack rumbles with hunger, waiting for a feast.

zh.name: 钝爪-掠食
zh.effect: 场上每有一名先锋干员，每3秒获得1点部署费用（最多叠加8层）
zh.flavor: 兽群饥肠辘辘，等待饱餐一顿。

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Protraction
relics.effect: For every Specialist Operator on the field, all enemies have -5% Movement Speed (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: If the host does not want guests, they'll never reach the door.

zh.name: 锈刃-久居
zh.effect: 场上每有一名特种干员，所有敌方单位的移动速度-5%（最多叠加8层）
zh.flavor: 主人不想见客，客人便到不了门前。

relics.name: Bend Spears - Rending
relics.effect: For every Guard Operator on the field, all allied units gain ATK +8% (Stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Those with power can always help each other to success.

zh.name: 折戟-裂岩
zh.effect: 场上每有一名近卫干员，所有我方单位的攻击力+8%（最多叠加8层）
zh.flavor: 拥有力量的人总能互相成就。

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Succession
relics.effect: For every Sniper Operator on the field, all allies gain ASPD +12 (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Hear the sound of the first arrow, as the last pierces the torso.

zh.name: 残弩-连珠
zh.effect: 场上每有一名狙击干员，所有我方单位的攻击速度+12（最多叠加8次）
zh.flavor: 听到第一支箭的声响，被最后一支箭穿过胸膛。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Rampart
relics.effect: For every Defender Operator on the field, all allies take 10% less physical damage (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Gather sand to form a tower, and gaze upon enemies from above.

zh.name: 铁卫-垒沙
zh.effect: 场上每有一名重装干员，所有我方单位受到的物理伤害-10%（最多叠加8次）
zh.flavor: 聚沙成塔，而后俯瞰群敌。

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Linkup
relics.effect: For every Supporter Operator on the field, increases the SP regen rate of Auto Recovery skills by +0.2/s (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: Hand in hand, shoulder to shoulder, brace yourselves, and look straight ahead.

zh.name: 支柱-联手
zh.effect: 场上每有一名辅助干员，所有自然回复技能的技力恢复+0.2/秒（最多叠加8次）
zh.flavor: 手拉手，肩并肩，做好准备，直视前方。

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Proficiency
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Vanguard Operators' skills is decreased by 35%
relics.flavor: As operators who are often the first to head into battle, what they have been through is unfathomable.

zh.name: 钝爪-熟稔
zh.effect: 所有【先锋】干员的技力消耗-35%
zh.flavor: 作为大部分时候最先进入战场的干员，你无法想象他们经历了多少。

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Burst
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators gain +10 Starting SP and +10% ATK
relics.flavor: He's already done all the reserve squad's work for them. What else do you expect?

zh.name: 钝爪-爆发
zh.effect: 所有【先锋】干员的初始技力+10，攻击力+10%
zh.flavor: 他已经把所有后续部队的事情都干完了，还要别人做什么？

relics.name: Bend Spears - Acuity
relics.effect: Guard Operators have +25% ATK
relics.flavor: 'This is the 7th blade you've broken this month.' 'But I cut down eight enemies this month.'

zh.name: 折戟-锋刃
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员的攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: “这是你这个月砍坏的第七把刀了。”“但是我这个月砍了八个敌人。”

relics.name: Bend Spears - Bloodbath
relics.effect: Guard Operators restore 2 SP after each attack
relics.flavor: Soldiers who get bolder as time passes are rare. Most need some form of psychological counseling to alleviate the trauma of war.

zh.name: 折戟-浴血
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员在攻击后获得2点技力
zh.flavor: 愈战愈勇的战士十分少见，我们常需要安排一些心理辅导来缓和战后的情绪。

relics.name: Bend Spears - Deathmatch
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -40% DEF, but gain +40% ATK and +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: I wouldn't really recommend learning those skills from Blaze.

zh.name: 折戟-破釜沉舟
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员的防御力-40%，但攻击力+40%，攻击速度+30
zh.flavor: 不太建议向煌学习那些技巧。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Invasion
relics.effect: Defender Operators have +60% ATK
relics.flavor: Defensive actions for the sake of teammates or strategic purposes often make people forget about their original aggressiveness.

zh.name: 铁卫-侵掠
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员的攻击力+60%
zh.flavor: 对队友和战略目的的保护行动往往会让人忽视他们原本的侵略性。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Consolidation
relics.effect: Defender Operators gain HP +40%, DEF +40%, and RES +20
relics.flavor: No matter how heavy fate's blow is, take it.

zh.name: 铁卫-整固
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员生命值+40%，防御力+40%，法术抗性+20
zh.flavor: 无论命运的打击多么沉重，扛下它。

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Precision
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +20% ATK
relics.flavor: In an era when Originium Arts were not as robust as they are now, Yan had a saying, 'a pierced willow leaf from a hundred paces,' to praise others for their mastery of archery.

zh.name: 残弩-百步穿杨
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的攻击力+20%
zh.flavor: 在源石技艺尚不如今天发达的时代，炎国曾以“百步穿杨”的典故来称赞他人箭术高超。

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Divine Speed
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have +70 ASPD
relics.flavor: It is said that the legendary archers of ancient Victoria could almost shoot a continuous stream of arrows.
relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Sniper Operators

zh.name: 残弩-神速
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的攻击速度+70
zh.flavor: 据说古维多利亚的传奇弓手可以让箭矢几乎连成一线。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名狙击干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: Broken Wand - Arts Weaving
relics.effect: Caster Operators have +25% ATK and +25 ASPD
relics.flavor: Those who gaze up at the great spires of Leithanien often see strange or even celestial phenomena.

zh.name: 断杖-织法者
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员的攻击力+25%，攻击速度+25
zh.flavor: 在莱塔尼亚仰望高塔的时候经常会看见一些奇怪的现象......甚至是天象。

relics.name: Broken Wand - Concentration
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Caster Operators by +0.4/s
relics.flavor: 'When a caster intends to go all out, they will display a completely different temperament — even if we're talking about something like Skyfire's grumpiness.'

zh.name: 断杖-凝神
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员的技力恢复+0.4/秒
zh.flavor: “当一个术师打算全力以赴，哪怕是天火小姐那种坏脾气术师，也会展露出截然不同的气质。”

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Diligence
relics.effect: The SP Cost of Supporter Operators' skills is decreased by 40%
relics.flavor: Operators tend to give it their all, even to tasks that might seem trivial. The reality is, those tasks are not trivial at all.

zh.name: 支柱-勤奋
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员的技力消耗-40%
zh.flavor: 即使是看似最微小的工作，干员们也会全力以赴。何况事实上，一点也不微小。

relics.name: Healer's Path - Self-Treating
relics.effect: Increases the SP regen rate of Medic Operators by +0.3/s
relics.flavor: Who says healers can't heal themselves? They simply pop some pills before continuing to help others.

zh.name: 医者-自医
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员的技力恢复+0.3/秒
zh.flavor: 谁说医者不能自医，他们只是选择给自己来一片提神药然后继续帮助别人而已。

relics.name: Healer's Path - Keen Hands
relics.effect: Medic Operators gain +50 ASPD
relics.flavor: Compared to snatching a life from the grip of death, what's three days of coma afterward?

zh.name: 医者-妙手
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员的攻击速度+50
zh.flavor: 比起从死亡手里多抢回一条命的伟业，事后昏睡个三天算什么？

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Advancement
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: There may be many means, but only one end.

zh.name: 锈刃-突破
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的部署费用-2，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 手段有很多，结局却只有一种。

relics.name: Rusted Blade - Execution
relics.effect: Specialist Operators have +30 ASPD
relics.flavor: Endless rust to scrape, and a bottomless list of tasks to complete.

zh.name: 锈刃-研磨
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的攻击速度+30
zh.flavor: 磨不完的锈迹，做不尽的工作。

relics.name: Rusted Blade - No Man's Land
relics.effect: The Redeployment Time of Specialist Operators -35%
relics.flavor: A shadow blinks, a faint sound stirs, and a life is taken. The audience is the next victim.

zh.name: 锈刃-可视静谧
zh.effect: 所有【特种】干员的再部署时间-35%
zh.flavor: 声音在阴影掠过的瞬间遇害，倾听它们的人将是下一位受害者。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Moving Fortress
relics.effect: Defender Operators gain +100% ATK and DEF and +1 Block for 20 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: Nobody can break through their defenses, and even fewer are able to escape from their assault. If every combatant has a mission, then that mission is to change the situation on the battlefield the moment they enter the fray.
relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

zh.name: 铁卫-临时要塞
zh.effect: 【重装】干员部署后20秒内攻击力和防御力+100%，且阻挡数+1
zh.flavor: 无人能越过他们的防线，更无人能在来犯后离开。若说每个战士都有其使命，那他们的使命，便是在入场那一刻改变战局。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名重装干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: Healer's Path - Wellspring
relics.effect: For every Medic Operator on the field, all allies gain Redeployment Time -5% (stacks up to 8 times)
relics.flavor: They are clear springs formed from flowing water, and they heal all that live.

zh.name: 医者-涌泉
zh.effect: 场上每有一名医疗干员，所有我方单位的再部署时间-5%（最多叠加8次）
zh.flavor: 他们是流水聚成的清泉，他们疗愈众生。

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Counter-Arts
relics.effect: Enemy units within the attack range of Supporter Operators have -30% DEF and -30% RES
relics.flavor: There are many ways to weaken an enemy's defensive capabilities: positional devices, armor-stripping Arts, marking weak points, and... giving them a stomachache.

zh.name: 支柱-枯法
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员攻击范围内的敌方单位防御力-30%，法术抗性-30%
zh.flavor: 弱化敌人的防御有很多手段：立场装置，法术彻甲，弱点标记，以及......让他们肚子疼。

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Mastery
relics.effect: For the first 60 seconds of battle, all Vanguards gain +100% ATK and +100% DEF
relics.flavor: 'When the darkly-clad enemies rushed towards me, there were only four words on my mind — they are done for.'

zh.name: 钝爪-百战
zh.effect: 战斗开始60秒内，所有【先锋】攻击力+100%，防御力+100%
zh.flavor: “当黑漆漆的敌人向我涌来时，我脑海里只想到四个字——它们完了。”

relics.name: Blunt Claws - Advancement
relics.effect: Vanguard Operators have -50% DP Cost and +60% Max HP
relics.flavor: Plant a great stone within the waters. Split the waves and part the fog.

zh.name: 钝爪-突破
zh.effect: 所有【先锋】干员的部署费用-50%，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 在波涛中插下顽石，分割巨浪，破开迷雾。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Advancement
relics.effect: Defender Operators have -6 DP Cost and +40% Max HP
relics.flavor: The shieldbearers formed a mountain range and became the earth. What they fight against are not enemies of flesh and blood. They fight against fate and injustice.

zh.name: 铁卫-突破
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员的部署费用-6，生命+40%
zh.flavor: 持盾者连成山脉，连成土地，他们对抗的不是血肉之敌，他们对抗命运，对抗不公。

relics.name: Bend Spears - Advancement
relics.effect: Guard Operators have -3 DP Cost, +40% Max HP, and gain 15% Physical Dodge
relics.flavor: The soldiers stepped onto the battlefield, drew their blades, and met in battle.

zh.name: 折戟-突破
zh.effect: 所有【近卫】干员的部署费用-3，生命+40%，获得15%物理闪避
zh.flavor: 战士走入战场，战士拔出战刃，战士迎接战斗。

relics.name: Iron Guard - Impenetrable
relics.effect: Defender Operators gain 2 SP after being attacked, and have -20% SP cost
relics.flavor: Every blow they endure will turn into anger and be returned severalfold.

zh.name: 铁卫-无锋
zh.effect: 所有【重装】干员在受到攻击后获得2点技力，并且技力消耗-20%
zh.flavor: 他们承受的每一次攻击，都将化作怒火数倍返还。

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Advancement
relics.effect: Sniper Operators have -2 DP Cost, +60% Max HP, and +100 DEF
relics.flavor: Load, aim, and fire. Destruction arrives as scheduled.

zh.name: 残弩-突破
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的部署费用-2，生命+60%，防御力+100
zh.flavor: 上膛，瞄准，开火，毁灭如期而至。

relics.name: Broken Wand - Advancement
relics.effect: Caster Operators have -3 DP Cost, +60% Max HP, and +10 RES
relics.flavor: Let Arts dance around your fingertips. Call the wind and rain, unravel reality, and achieve your grand goals.

zh.name: 断杖-突破
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员的部署费用-3，生命+60%，法术抗性+10
zh.flavor: 让技艺在指尖起舞，呼风唤雨，搅乱现实，达成你宏伟的目的。

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Advancement
relics.effect: Supporter Operators have -2 DP Cost, +40% Max HP, and gain 15% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: Whenever you're 'almost done' with a task, what you need at that moment is someone to help you with the 'almost' part.

zh.name: 支柱-突破
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员的部署费用-2，生命+40%，获得15%法术闪避
zh.flavor: 当“差一点完成任务”的时候，你需要的正是那个帮你补上“差一点”的人。

relics.name: Stalwart Aid - Assistance
relics.effect: Supporter Operators grant +30% ATK to allied units within their attack range
relics.flavor: Proper meals, correct paths, or simply having a heart-to-heart... Victory is won through these little things.

zh.name: 支柱-援护
zh.effect: 所有【辅助】干员使攻击范围内的我方单位攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 递上饭食、指明路线、甚至是促膝谈心，胜败的关键就在这点滴之间。

relics.name: Healer's Path - Advancement
relics.effect: Medic Operators have -2 DP Cost and +60% HP
relics.flavor: The desire to save lives is a virtue that mankind must applaud, for that is the support that keeps us alive.

zh.name: 医者-突破
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员的部署费用-2，生命+60%
zh.flavor: 拯救是人类必须赞许的美德，是这一切得以存续的仰仗。

relics.name: Healer's Path - Restore Sanity
relics.effect: Medic Operators receive +20% healing effectiveness, and allied Operators within their attack range gain Resistance
relics.flavor: Making one's body as solid as a nomadic city is a bit of a romanticized description, but our medics are ready to put that idea into practice.

zh.name: 医者-固化序列
zh.effect: 所有【医疗】干员受到的治疗和生命回复效果+20%，并且攻击范围内的我方干员获得抵抗
zh.flavor: 让躯体如移动城市般坚实虽是一种理想化描述，医者们已经准备好将此创想付诸实践了。

relics.name: Fatal Bolts - Crossfire
relics.effect: Sniper Operators gain +40% ATK
relics.flavor: The dense crossfire also exposes snipers to great danger. The next battle boils down to a game of vision.

zh.name: 残弩-交叉火力
zh.effect: 所有【狙击】干员的攻击力+40%
zh.flavor: 密集的火力网布置同时让狙击干员们暴露在危险之中，接下来是一场关于准星的博弈。

relics.name: Broken Wand - Malediction
relics.effect: Caster Operators deal +70% Arts Damage
relics.flavor: It is virtually impossible to identify when the Sarkaz first encountered Originium, and the origins of these ancient Arts have long been separated from actual reality and common sense.

zh.name: 断杖-苦难巫咒
zh.effect: 所有【术师】干员造成的法术伤害+70%
zh.flavor: 萨卡兹接触源石的起源几乎无从考证，古老法术的起点早已脱离物质现实与逻辑常理。

relics.name: Antique Casting
relics.effect: Immediately Promote 3 Operators (Does not require Hope)
relics.flavor: 'Harken, the forge of the sky, awaits five earthborn metals'... Even though it can be used for all kinds of work, nobody understands its exact mechanism.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, promote a total of 35 Operators

zh.name: 古旧铸物
zh.effect: 立即进阶三个干员（不消耗希望）
zh.flavor: “天有洪炉，地生五金”......虽然可以用来成就各种事业，却没人知道具体原理。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计进阶总共35名干员

relics.name: Rhodes Island Tactical Transceiver
relics.effect: Gain an additional choice when Recruitment Vouchers are dropped after battle
relics.flavor: Hang in there, help's on the way.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, recruit a total of 70 Operators

zh.name: 罗德岛战术电台
zh.effect: 战斗后掉落招募券时，增加一个可选项
zh.flavor: 保持联络，支援马上抵达。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计招募总共70名干员

relics.name: Knight Lance Pro
relics.effect: Treasure Chests on the battlefield will drop more Originium Ingots
relics.flavor: Don't worry if your own strength isn't enough! Use these tiny levers to move more, and win more in every round! The grand prize is a holiday trip to Sami!

zh.name: 骑士长枪专业版
zh.effect: 战场的宝箱会掉落更多的源石锭
zh.flavor: 不用担心自身力量不足！利用小小的杠杆，在每一局中撬动更多，赢得更多！大奖将是萨米假日之旅！

relics.name: Children of the Walls
relics.effect: Operators deployed on the 8 tiles surrounding the Objective Point gain +2 Block and +50% Max HP
relics.flavor: The Children of Soil and Stone carefully taught the ancient city of Kazdel how to toughen itself and protect its people behind its walls. With the advent of a protracted peace, it was broken into many little pieces and turned into amulets for adventurers heading into unexplored lands.

zh.name: 城墙之子
zh.effect: 部署在蓝色目标点周围8格的干员阻挡数+2，最大生命值+50%
zh.flavor: 土石之子精心培育了卡兹戴尔的古老城垣，教会了它如何使自己变得刚韧，以保护身后的人民。随着长久和平的时代到来，它被拆分成了许多小块，作为护身符赠给了前往未知之地的探险家们。

relics.name: Golden Chalice
relics.effect: For each 5 Originium Ingots in possession, all allied units have +7 ASPD
relics.flavor: Saints, knights, and believers. All of them are madmen. Dear God, even the chalice itself is made of pure gold!
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure with at least 20 Originium Ingots remaining

zh.name: 金酒之杯
zh.effect: 每有5源石锭，所有我方单位的攻击速度+7
zh.flavor: 圣人、骑士、虔信之徒，无人不为之疯狂。老天啊，连杯子本身都是纯金的！
zh.unlock: 剩余不小于20源石锭时完成游戏结局

relics.name: Slave Hunter
relics.effect: Units that become Levitated, Weightless, or are shifted will take 50% more damage for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: After obtaining Nasti's designs, the Sarkaz put them to use in war right away. They flew into the sky, dominating the Ancients with waves of wrath, and the never-ending war entered a new stage.

zh.name: 奴隶猎捕器
zh.effect: 进入浮空、失衡与失重状态的单位受到的伤害提升50%，持续10秒
zh.flavor: 获取娜斯提的设计后，萨卡兹立刻将其运用到了战争之中，他们飞上天空，以绝对优势向着先民倾泻怒火。一场永不停歇的战争就此进入了新的阶段。

relics.name: Polar Retrofit Package
relics.effect: When used, Support items will also be used simultaneously on the adjacent 4 tiles
relics.flavor: Proudly produced by the Volvort Kochinski Extreme Environment Equipment Testing Department. It can modify a variety of devices, adapting them for polar regions and increasing their effectiveness in cold environments.

zh.name: 极地改型包
zh.effect: 支援道具使用时会在周围4格同时使用
zh.flavor: 沃尔沃特科钦斯基极端环境设备测试部荣誉出品。能对各种通用型号装置进行极地适应性改修，令其在寒冷环境下发挥更大效用。

relics.name: Northwind Construct
relics.effect: [Transformed] enemies are inflicted with Fear for 5 seconds the first time they deal damage
relics.flavor: Though she often fails, she is still committed to helping those who would challenge their tragic fates.
relics.unlock: Win the operation [Glittering] without losing any Life Point

zh.name: 北风的造物
zh.effect: 【化物】敌人首次造成伤害时，立即恐惧自身5秒
zh.flavor: 即使常常以失败告终，她仍热衷于为挑战悲惨命运之人提供帮助。
zh.unlock: 在不损失目标生命的情况下胜利作战【闪闪发光】

relics.name: Cannot's Mark
relics.effect: When you clear an adventure while holding this collectible, 60% of your current Originium Ingots are converted into Prospective Investment System balance (up to 60 per adventure)
relics.flavor: Some are willing to do favors for Cannot to maintain good terms, while others deserve the same treatment from Cannot.
relics.unlock: Invest a total of 250 with the Prospective Investment System

zh.name: 坎诺特印记
zh.effect: 携带此收藏品并通关时，当前源石锭的60%将会转化为前瞻性投资系统的余额（单局可获得的余额上限为60）
zh.flavor: 有人愿意卖坎诺特一个面子，也有人值得坎诺特卖个“面子”。
zh.unlock: 在“前瞻性投资系统”中的累计投资额达到250

relics.name: "Three Questions of the Fist Canon"
relics.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, they gain +5% ATK (stacks up to 40 times)
relics.flavor: Shuo's first martial arts notebook, recording his thoughts on boxing. First, the question of technique; second, the question of intent; third, the question of the martial realm. They say it was so obscure his students couldn't follow it, so he consulted his younger sister and revised it.

zh.name: 《拳经三问》
zh.effect: 干员每使用过一次技能，自身的攻击力+5%，最多叠加40层
zh.flavor: 朔的第一本武学笔记，记录了他对拳法的思考。一问拳招，二问拳意，三问武境。据说言语晦涩，学生苦读不懂，他向妹妹请教后又做了改良。

relics.name: Ink Treasure of Dawn and Dusk
relics.effect: At the start of battle, randomly obtain a Tactical Prop usable only in that battle
relics.flavor: The bubbles Lin blows one after another while swimming through the scroll bring strange effects. The scroll's owner doesn't mind people touching them; before long, they burst and scatter on the wind anyway.

zh.name: 旦夕墨宝
zh.effect: 战斗开始时，随机获得一件仅用于该次战斗的战术道具
zh.flavor: 鳞在画卷中游动时吐出的一个又一个泡泡，会带来一些奇异之效。画卷主人不在乎有人擅自触碰它们，反正过不了多久，它们就会破裂，随风消散。

relics.name: Chang Workshop Ledger
relics.effect: Tactical Props, Summons, and Devices have -10 DP Cost
relics.flavor: Liu'er eagerly invited you to "try out" the Chang Workshop's new inventions. You declined, pleading empty pockets, only to watch her briskly scribble a few lines in the ledger. Now your excuse no longer holds.

zh.name: 伥物房账簿
zh.effect: 战术道具，召唤物，装置的部署费用减10
zh.flavor: 柳儿热情邀请你“试用”伥物房的新发明，你以囊中羞涩为由婉拒，却看到她爽快地在账簿上划拉了几笔。现在，你的理由不成立了。

relics.name: Training Lightning Rod
relics.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, their natural SP recovery increases by 0.4/s (stacks up to 5 times)
relics.flavor: The site for practicing thunder arts atop the Tianshi Academy's mountain. Apprentices learning to call down lightning all rely on the rod until practice makes perfect. At the Academy it's nicknamed "Senior".

zh.name: 修习雷针
zh.effect: 干员每使用过一次技能，自身的技力自然回复速度+0.4/秒，最多叠加5层
zh.flavor: 位于天师府山巅的修习雷法之所。雷法学徒初学引雷之时，都需借助雷针，直至熟能生巧。在天师府别名“前辈”。

relics.name: Fire Poker
relics.effect: When any Operator damages a [Transformed] enemy, they deal an additional instance of Arts Damage equal to 50% of their ATK
relics.flavor: With this stick the old Tianshi swept away demons and broke colossal beasts, unstoppable. But most of the time it leans quietly in a corner of the kitchen, picked up only to feed the stove and stir the fire.

zh.name: 烧火棍
zh.effect: 所有干员对【化物】造成伤害时，额外造成一次相当于攻击力50%的法术伤害
zh.flavor: 老天师提着这根木棍扫邪魔破巨兽所向披靡。但大多数时候，它都静静靠在厨房一角，只有给炉灶添柴拨火时才会被拿起。

relics.name: Fire-Lit Beast Kite
relics.effect: Gain 1 Candlelight each time you enter Sui's Remnant Mind
relics.flavor: A kite modeled on a colossal beast. Its streamers are lit with candlelight that neither goes out nor burns the kite. Fly it on ordinary days; step into Sui's consciousness, and its glow lets you go one step further.

zh.name: 引火兽筝
zh.effect: 每次进入岁兽残识时获得1点烛火
zh.flavor: 参照巨兽造型设计制作的风筝。飘带用烛火点燃，不灭，也不毁风筝。平日里放飞，在步入岁识时可借其火光，多行一步。

relics.name: "Fortune and Misfortune Entwined"
relics.effect: Gain 1 Ticket whenever a Fierce Coin is added to the Coin Box
relics.flavor: If you come across half a line of verse in the Garden, press this peachwood charm onto it at once. A small misfortune is unavoidable, but fortune hides within misfortune. Do not finish the couplet. Do not finish the couplet. Do not finish the couplet.

zh.name: “福祸相依”
zh.effect: 钱盒中加入厉钱时，获得1张票券
zh.flavor: 如在界园中遇到半行诗，须迅速将此桃木挂饰按压其上。小灾已不可免，然而，祸兮福之所倚。切勿对诗。切勿对诗。切勿对诗。

relics.name: Home-Style Stir-Fry
relics.effect: All Operators gain +20% Max HP and +20% ATK; the effect increases by a further 10% for each battle cleared in Sui's Remnant Mind
relics.flavor: Heaven for a lid, earth for a wok; laughter and scolding are the seasoning. As long as people are willing to eat properly, they can still live properly.

zh.name: 家常小炒
zh.effect: 所有干员的生命值+20%，攻击力+20%；每通过一场岁兽残识中的战斗，效果额外提升10%
zh.flavor: 天为盖，地为锅，嬉笑怒骂，皆为调味。人哪，只要愿意好好吃饭，也就还能好好活着。

relics.name: Rhodes Island Emergency Rescue Vehicle
relics.effect: Hope +2; during battles in Sui's Remnant Mind, a random Rhodes Island Elite Operator arrives as support
relics.flavor: Wherever your orders send them, Elite Operators will see the mission through!
relics.unlock: Select 'Tactical Destruction Squad' and complete your adventure

zh.name: 罗德岛应急救援车
zh.effect: 希望+2，在岁兽残识战斗时，获得1名随机的罗德岛精英干员支援
zh.flavor: 无论你的指令是去往何处——精英干员，使命必达！
zh.unlock: 选择【破坏战术分队】完成游戏结局

relics.name: Wooden Knot
relics.effect: Candlelight +2 the next time you enter Sui's Remnant Mind; gain 10 Tickets after completing all Gleanings and Legend nodes in Sui's Remnant Mind
relics.flavor: An utterly ordinary Chang object. According to Liu'er, it is a treasure collected from the shores of the Eastern Sea. Yet apart from the warm grain of the wood and a refreshing fragrance, there seems to be nothing special about it...

zh.name: 木疙瘩
zh.effect: 下一次进入岁兽残识时，烛火+2；完成所有岁兽残识中的拾遗和传说节点后，获得10票券
zh.flavor: 平平无奇的伥物，据柳儿所说，乃是东海之滨收研的珍物。但除了木质温润，有股提神清香外，似乎并没有什么特别的......

relics.name: Flying Pack-Beast Coach
relics.effect: For each [Candle Attendant] in the squad, all [Candle Attendants] gain +5 ASPD (stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: A beast-drawn vehicle all the rage when Yan's highways first opened. As the highways spread and faster, sturdier vehicles rose, the pack beasts racing along them gradually vanished, and with them the thrill of a ride that might fling you onto the road at any moment.

zh.name: 飞驮客运
zh.effect: 编队中每有一名【伺烛客】，所有【伺烛客】攻击速度+5（最大叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 炎国驰道初开时风靡一时的畜力载具。随着驰道普及，更高速耐久的载具兴起，驰道上飞奔的驮兽身影逐渐消失，随时可能被甩上大道的刺激乘车体验也慢慢被人们遗忘。

relics.name: Boss Bao's Voucher
relics.effect: Starting DP +1 for every 3 Originium Ingots held
relics.flavor: "Boss Bao is watching you."

zh.name: 鲍老板的凭证
zh.effect: 每有3源石锭，初始的部署费用+1
zh.flavor: “鲍老板正盯着你。”

relics.name: Log Wheel
relics.effect: Starting DP +5, plus an additional +10 for each [Vanguard] in the squad
relics.flavor: Boulders tumbling down the mountains smashed the crystal clusters left by catastrophes, and first gave people the idea of moving quickly.

zh.name: 圆木轮
zh.effect: 初始费用+5，编队里每有一名【先锋】，初始费用额外+10
zh.flavor: 群山中翻滚而下的圆石砸碎了天灾形成的晶簇，也第一次给予了人们快速移动的灵感。

relics.name: Two-Bearer Sedan Chair
relics.effect: Max DP +15, all [Vanguards] gain +25% ATK, and refund the full DP cost when deployed
relics.flavor: A chair and two poles, and people were divided into high and low. Today, sedan chairs mostly sit in museums, yet how many still dream in their hearts of being carried, high above everyone else?

zh.name: 二抬肩舆
zh.effect: 部署费用上限+15，所有【先锋】攻击力+25%，部署时，返还扣除的所有费用
zh.flavor: 一张椅子两根棍，将人分了个上下高低。如今，轿子已大多进了博物馆，可多少人心中还想着由人抬起，高高在上呢？

relics.name: Whistling Arrow Blowpipe
relics.effect: When an Operator loses 30% of their HP, inflict Fear on all enemies within their attack range for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: A blowpipe for signals and warnings. Stained with blood, its whistling arrow shrieks so piercingly and so mournfully on release that listeners instinctively want to flee.

zh.name: 鸣镝吹筒
zh.effect: 干员损失30%的生命值时，对攻击范围内的所有敌人造成一次10秒的恐惧
zh.flavor: 用于发讯与示警的吹箭筒，若是沾了血，鸣镝发射时啸叫声震耳欲聋，凄烈无比，令人下意识想要逃离。

relics.name: Strange-Eater Beast Statue
relics.effect: When 3 Fierce Coins are tossed, immediately gain +3 Max Life Points and 3 Objective Shield
relics.flavor: A shelled-beast statue in a pond; tossing coins to it has never worked. A naughty child threw rubbish in, and the statue opened its mouth and swallowed it; the child burst into tears. The statue opened its mouth again and spat out a pretty pearl, and the child was overjoyed.

zh.name: 异食兽像
zh.effect: 投出3枚厉钱时，立即获得3点目标生命上限，3点护盾
zh.flavor: 池中壳兽像，向它投币从未灵验。淘气顽童投以垃圾，石像张口便吞，顽童嚎啕大哭；石像复又张口，吐出漂亮珠子，顽童遂欢天喜地。

relics.name: Threefold Good Fortune
relics.effect: When 3 Flower Coins are tossed, immediately gain 8 Originium Ingots and 1 Hope
relics.flavor: At dawn, birdsong and a painted sky; in spring, osmanthus scent and rolling clouds; in winter, the south wind and frost like flowers.

zh.name: 吉运有三
zh.effect: 投出3枚花钱时，立即获得8源石锭，1希望
zh.flavor: 朝闻羽啼天似画，春嗅桂花云翻浪，冬起南风霜似花。

relics.name: Brewing Mountains and Rivers
relics.effect: For each Flower Coin in the Coin Box, all Operators gain +10% ATK and +20% Max HP
relics.flavor: Cheap wine or fine nectar, take a ladle of each. Rushing rivers and flying falls, all into the gourd. Within the gourd, heaven and earth turn on their own; taste it years later and the flavor is something else entirely.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, win a total of 20 battles

zh.name: 酿山河
zh.effect: 钱盒内每存在一枚花钱，所有干员获得+10%攻击力，+20%生命值
zh.flavor: 劣酒琼浆，皆取一瓢。奔河飞瀑，尽入葫中。葫中自有天地转，经年再品滋味殊。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利20场战斗

relics.name: Old Beacon's Lingering Dream
relics.effect: For each Fierce Coin tossed so far, Command EXP gained from battles +15%
relics.flavor: Sudden thunder and pouring rain; the din of war rises to the sky. Clashing spears and armored cavalry come trampling through the dream.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, win a total of 35 battles

zh.name: 旧烽遗梦
zh.effect: 当前每投出一枚厉钱，战斗获得的指挥经验+15%
zh.flavor: 惊雷骤雨，战嚣冲天。金戈铁骑，踏梦而来。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利35场战斗

relics.name: Ringing War Drum
relics.effect: Each coin toss grants all Operators +15% ATK (stacks up to 10 times); if only Fierce Coins are tossed, gain 1 additional stack
relics.flavor: A "veteran" of the army. It once relayed orders on the battlefield, weathering wind and frost, witnessing victory and defeat. It has since been replaced by more advanced means of signaling, but soldiers can still hear the war drum rumble before setting out, lifting their spirits.
relics.unlock: Across multiple adventures, clear a total of 50 battles

zh.name: 铿金征鼓
zh.effect: 每次投钱，所有干员攻击力+15％（最多叠加10次），若只投掷出厉钱，则额外获得1次叠加次数
zh.flavor: 军中一员“老将”。曾于阵上传令，历风霜，见胜败。如今，它已被更先进的传令方式替下，但战士出征前仍可闻征鼓隆隆，提振士气。
zh.unlock: 在多局游戏中累计胜利50场战斗

relics.name: "Plucked Balance"
relics.effect: All [Melee] Operators gain +35% Max HP and +35% ATK
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “摘衡”
zh.effect: 所有【近战】干员，生命值+35%，攻击力+35%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Plucked Flower"
relics.effect: All [Melee] Operators have +3 DP Cost, +1 Block, and +50% DEF
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “摘花”
zh.effect: 所有【近战】干员，部署费用+3，阻挡数+1，防御力+50%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Plucked Ferocity"
relics.effect: All [Melee] Operators restore HP equal to 5% of their Max HP per second for 20 seconds after deployment
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “摘厉”
zh.effect: 所有【近战】干员部署后每秒恢复相当于最大生命值5%的生命值，持续20秒
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Tossed Balance"
relics.effect: All [Ranged] Operators gain +25% Max HP and +25% ATK
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “掷衡”
zh.effect: 所有【远程】干员，生命值+25%，攻击力+25%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Tossed Flower"
relics.effect: All [Ranged] Operators have +2 DP Cost and gain 2 layers of Shield when deployed
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “掷花”
zh.effect: 所有【远程】干员部署费用+2，部署时获得2层护盾
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Tossed Ferocity"
relics.effect: All [Ranged] Operators gain Resistance and +15% Arts Dodge
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “掷厉”
zh.effect: 所有【远程】干员获得抵抗，法术闪避+15%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Seen Balance"
relics.effect: When an enemy becomes Imbalanced, it has -30% DEF and RES for 10 seconds
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “见衡”
zh.effect: 敌人进入失衡状态后，防御力，法术抗性-30%，持续10秒
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Seen Flower"
relics.effect: Each time an Operator uses a skill, they gain a Barrier equal to 10% of their Max HP for 10 seconds (does not stack)
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “见花”
zh.effect: 干员每次释放技能时，获得相当于最大生命值10%的屏障，持续10秒（不可叠加）
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Seen Ferocity"
relics.effect: Allied Operators deal +50% Physical and Arts Damage to [Transformed] enemies
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “见厉”
zh.effect: 我方干员对【化物】敌人造成的物理和法术伤害提高50%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Sui's Balance"
relics.effect: [Candle Attendants] gain +50% ATK and +50% DEF
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “岁衡”
zh.effect: 【伺烛客】的攻击力+50%，防御力+50%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Sui's Flower"
relics.effect: All Operators have +3 DP Cost; for each [Candle Attendant] in the squad, [Candle Attendants] gain +10% Max HP, ATK, and DEF
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “岁花”
zh.effect: 所有干员的部署费用+3，编队中每有一名【伺烛客】，则【伺烛客】的生命值，攻击力，防御力+10%
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: "Sui's Ferocity"
relics.effect: [Candle Attendants] gain +100% ATK for 10 seconds after deployment; each time an Operator becomes a [Candle Attendant] through an operation, the duration is extended by 5 seconds (up to 15 times)
relics.flavor: Two talismans joined as one; how much of the old friends' past remains?

zh.name: “岁厉”
zh.effect: 【伺烛客】部署后10秒内攻击力+100%，每有干员通过作战成为【伺烛客】时，持续时间+5秒(最多提升15次)
zh.flavor: 双符相合，故人昔事几何？

relics.name: Hidden Butterfly Ink
relics.effect: While you hold this collectible, operations will be attacked by "Sui's Body"
relics.flavor: A Chang object Liu'er is researching, made from Shuo's martial manuals and fragments of stone from Sui's Mausoleum. It was meant to be black ink for carving Sui, but Sui's form escaped, so a butterfly took its place. Yet the butterfly fears Sui's might, and Sui must be driven off to calm it.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

zh.name: 隐蝶墨
zh.effect: 携带此收藏品时，作战会遭遇“岁躯”的袭击
zh.flavor: 柳儿在研究的伥物，采朔之武籍，研岁陵残石而成。本为雕岁乌墨，岁形已逸，以蝶替之，然蝶畏岁威，需驱岁以安蝶。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

relics.name: Ink-Stained Stele Fragment
relics.effect: At the start of battle, a random Operator's DP Cost becomes 0 for that battle; while you hold this collectible, you can lead the expedition in a different direction at Fate's Direction
relics.flavor: With the butterfly resting on the ink, "writing" emerges from beneath layer upon layer of wrapping. The lost portions can no longer be made out, but judging from the shapes and radicals of the characters, it is a letter of longing for family far away.
relics.unlock: Complete an adventure

zh.name: 墨化残碑
zh.effect: 战斗开始时，随机选择一名干员，使该干员本场战斗的部署费用变为0，携带此收藏品时，可以在命运所指中让探索开启不同的方向
zh.flavor: 蝶驻墨端，“文字”于层层包裹之下显现。失佚的部分已不可明辨，但依字形与偏旁推测，这是一份对于亲属的遥思。
zh.unlock: 完成游戏结局

relics.name: Cloud and Lacquer
relics.effect: Operators lose 2% of their Max HP per second for 60s after deployment; leads the expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: People have right and wrong; the board has black and white. But whether things are seen clearly or not, the colossal beast does not care. Even if open plots in black ink remake heaven and earth, you still need Sui's consent to enter Sui's Mausoleum.

zh.name: 云与漆
zh.effect: 干员部署后60s内，每秒流失2%的最大生命值，让探索开启不同的方向
zh.flavor: 人有是非对错，棋有正反黑白，但见得分明与否，巨兽并不在意。就算明谋黑字改换天地，你也仍需得岁意，才可入岁陵。

relics.name: Life-Forgetting Go Puzzle
relics.effect: Operators lose 50% of their SP after deployment; while you hold this collectible, a special operation appears in Guidance
relics.flavor: A single block of wood, a Go board on the front and a movable-type tray on the back, leaning on each other as if seamless. The type will not print anything, only because one piece carved with "Jiye" juts out and cannot be pressed down no matter what.

zh.name: 忘生珍珑
zh.effect: 干员部署后损失50%的技力值；携带此收藏品时，指点迷津中会出现一场特殊的作战
zh.flavor: 一方木料，正面为棋盘，背面则为活字盘，互相倚靠，似无缝隙。活字无法印下内容，只因一枚刻有“吉页”的活字凸出，怎么都摁不下去。

relics.name: Unsealed Long Box
relics.effect: Leader and Elite enemies have +30% DEF and +20 ASPD; at the end of a stage, lose 1 Life Point for each Carved Chang still on the field (cannot drop below 1); has a wondrous effect in One Step Ahead
relics.flavor: A storage box that easily drifts into Sui's Remnant Mind. No name, no painting, no carving, no seal.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 无封长盒
zh.effect: 领袖与精英敌人防御力+30%，攻击速度+20，关卡结束时每有一个仍在场的雕伥，失去1目标生命值（不会低于1），在先行一步中有奇妙的作用
zh.flavor: 易流落于岁兽残识中的藏盒。失名失绘，无刻无印。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: Inkless Long Scroll
relics.effect: Hope +3; makes the Dreadful Foes in Jianzi Shrine more difficult, leading the expedition in a different direction
relics.flavor: The shared memories of people and Sui open the box, and the long scroll reaches out to find a past that can put ink upon this blank white.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion I], complete an adventure

zh.name: 无墨长卷
zh.effect: 希望+3，使见字祠中的险路恶敌更加艰难，让探索开启不同的方向
zh.flavor: 人与岁兽共同的记忆将藏盒开启，长卷远探，寻找能在这方素白上着墨的往昔。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 一】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: Reminiscence Device
relics.effect: On obtaining, lose all Originium Ingots and Hope, and Command EXP and Originium Ingots gained after battles are reduced by 50%; has a special use in Wonderland Astray
relics.flavor: Created by Sui's proxies to deal with Sui. In nearly endless rotation, it strips bare every possibility of Sui's awakening so that Wang can plan ahead.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion II], complete an adventure

zh.name: 追忆仪
zh.effect: 获得时，失去所有的源石锭及希望，并使战斗后获得的指挥等级经验和源石锭-50％。在误入奇境有特殊用处
zh.flavor: 由岁兽代理人创造，用以应对岁兽的造物，会在几无尽头的旋转中，剥露出其苏醒的一切可能性以供望提前谋划。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 二】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: "Little Grindy"
relics.effect: Natural DP recovery is reduced by 50%; leads the expedition in a different direction; has a special use at the Old Shop
relics.flavor: An ink Chang raised on memories fed to it by Sui's proxies together. It isn't very quick on its feet, yet across countless possibilities it helps hold down Sui's stirring consciousness.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion II], complete an adventure

zh.name: “小磨唧”
zh.effect: 费用自然回复速度降低50％，让探索开启不同的方向。在故肆有特殊用处
zh.flavor: 被岁兽代理人共同用记忆喂养起来的墨伥，动作不太麻利，却在无数可能性中从旁协助压制岁将醒的意识。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 二】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: Unforgiven
relics.effect: All enemy units gain +50% Max HP and DEF; "Su'ao" and some "Forms" gain the ability to continuously summon enemies
relics.flavor: A strange object born while depicting Sui. Even unawakened, Sui will not let others trample Its body; the body's reflexes search for every sign of change.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion II], complete an adventure

zh.name: 不赦
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的生命值、防御力+50％，使“宿傲”和部分“身形”获得持续召唤敌人的能力
zh.flavor: 描绘岁兽时诞生的奇物。即使尚未苏醒，岁兽也不会任由别人践踏祂的身躯，躯体的反射正在搜寻一切变化的预兆。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 二】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: Unceasing
relics.effect: All enemy units gain +30% ATK; [Candle Attendants] and their summons have -10% ATK and Max HP in operations outside Sui's Remnant Mind, a further -10% for each new floor, and an additional -50% upon entering "Laiqu"
relics.flavor: A strange object born while depicting Sui. Even unawakened, Sui will not let others rifle through Its memories and thoughts; the reach of Its perception forcefully blocks every change.
relics.unlock: After [Expansion II], complete an adventure

zh.name: 不息
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位的攻击力+30％；【伺烛客】及其召唤物在非岁兽残识作战时攻击力、生命值-10％，每进入新的一层，额外-10％。进入“来去处”时，额外-50％
zh.flavor: 描绘岁兽时诞生的奇物。即使尚未苏醒，岁兽也不会任由别人翻动祂的记忆与思维，知觉的延伸正在强硬地阻止一切变动。
zh.unlock:
【内容拓展 · 二】后，完成
一次游戏结局

relics.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
relics.effect: All enemies take +150% True damage
relics.flavor: A small, black crown.

zh.name: “文明的存续”
zh.effect: 所有敌方单位受到的真实伤害+150%
zh.flavor: 小小的黑色王冠。

relics.name: Charging Beast Chariot
relics.effect: Max DP +30; while DP is 99 or above, all units gain +50% Max HP and +1 Block
relics.flavor: A box, two wheels, and four charging beasts: surely far more efficient than humans on two legs? Look at the Khagan's nightmare elite. Even galloping on sixteen legs, a beast-drawn chariot cannot outrun the pace of change on Terra.

zh.name: 奔兽战车
zh.effect: 部署费用上限+30，部署费用为99及以上时，所有单位生命值+50%，阻挡数+1
zh.flavor: 一个箱子两个轮，牵起四匹奔兽，其效率当然要远超两条腿走路的人类——吗？看看可汗的梦魇精兵吧。兽拉战车就算用十六条腿竭力奔驰，也追不上泰拉变化的速度。

relics.name: Pack-Beast Bastion
relics.effect: Max DP +15; while DP is 99 or above, enemy units within 12 tiles of the Protection Objective lose Invisibility and have -35% accuracy
relics.flavor: Nimble warriors fanned out to guard the people gathered on the pack beasts' backs, heading for a promised land the catastrophes had yet to reach. This was the first "mobile city".

zh.name: 驮垒
zh.effect: 部署费用上限+15，部署费用为99及以上时，保护目标点周围12格的敌方单位失去隐匿并且命中率下降35%
zh.flavor: 矫健的勇士四散而开，拱卫着聚在驮兽背上的人们，向着天灾未至的乐土而去。这便是最初的“移动城市”。

relics.name: "Little Baizao"
relics.effect: When an Operator is deployed, deal True Damage equal to a portion of their DP Cost to all enemies on the field; if the DP Cost is 30 or more, also Stun them for 5 seconds
relics.flavor: The crystallization of war, Originium, blood, and tears.

zh.name: “小百灶”
zh.effect: 干员部署时，对全场所有敌人造成自身部署费用一定比例的真实伤害；若部署费用不小于30，还会造成5秒的晕眩
zh.flavor: 战争、源石与血泪的结晶。

relics.name: "Cangtong"
relics.effect: While DP is 99 or above, deal 3000 Arts Damage and a 2-second Stun to all enemies on the field every 10 seconds
relics.flavor: Lin Qingyan's sword. It makes no sound when drawn, hiding its brilliance like plain wood. Cloaked in azure thunder, it would surely tear through wind and skim through fire, arriving in an instant.

zh.name: “苍桐”
zh.effect: 部署费用为99及以上时，每隔10秒对全场敌人造成一次3000点的法术伤害和2秒的晕眩
zh.flavor: 麟青砚的配剑，出鞘不吟，藏巧守拙如木。若披覆苍霆，必是破风掠火，瞬息即至。

relics.name: 'End of Times'
relics.effect: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration
relics.flavor: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
relics.unlock: In a single battle, lose a total of 8 Life Points (including mission failures)

zh.name: “时光之末”
zh.effect: 仅一次，在非区域最终战斗和领袖战中失败时不结束探索，目标生命+1并继续下一步行动
zh.flavor: 只要到达不了新的循环，过错就还有机会挽回。
zh.unlock: 在一次战斗中累计失去8目标生命（包含战斗失败）

relics.name: A String of Coin Chang
relics.effect: When the battle begins, randomize all allied operators' Deployment Cost
relics.flavor: Eight coins as one, yet once they became Chang each had its own ideas. Even if you grab the string holding them together, they won't behave.

zh.name: 一串钱伥
zh.effect: 战斗开始时，打乱所有干员的部署费用
zh.flavor: 八钱一体，成伥后却各有想法。即使抓住串起它们的线，也并不老实。

relics.name: Four-Quarter Pigments
relics.effect: Once per battle, when 4 Operators are deployed, the next Operator deployed gains +50% Max HP, +50% DEF, and +5 Block
relics.flavor: Pigments mixed by Dusk herself, rarely seen in this world, and also her seal. Dip the brush, and four colors settle into a single scene.

zh.name: 四方绘料
zh.effect: 每场战斗仅一次，已部署4名干员时，下一名部署的干员获得生命值+50%，防御力+50%，阻挡数+5
zh.flavor: 夕亲自调制，世所罕见的颜料，同时也是她的印信。蘸染时，四色置单景。

relics.name: Four-Seasons Painting Brush
relics.effect: Once per battle, when 4 Operators are deployed, the next Operator deployed gains Resistance, +50% ATK, and takes 50% less Elemental Injury
relics.flavor: A brush made by Dusk herself, rarely seen in this world, and also her seal. Put brush to paper, and the four seasons are forever as one.

zh.name: 四时丹青毫
zh.effect: 每场战斗仅一次，已部署4名干员时，下一名部署的干员获得抵抗，攻击力+50%，受到的元素损伤降低50%
zh.flavor: 夕亲自制作，世所罕见的毛笔，同时也是她的印信。下笔时，四时恒如一。

relics.name: Soldier's Shadow
relics.effect: Each time the rightmost Operator in the deployment area is deployed, all Operators on the field gain a Barrier equal to a portion of the DP spent
relics.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a soldier who defended a city. Legend says he held it for a hundred days with a handful of men during a border war; when the city fell, he stood tall atop the wall and was swallowed by the yellow sands with it. After Yumen was built, a statue was raised in his memory.
relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Defender Operators

zh.name: 士影
zh.effect: 每次部署待部署区最右侧的干员时，使全场干员获得消耗费用一定比例的屏障
zh.flavor: 为纪念一位守城将士而制的皮影。传闻其在边防战中带数名士兵守城百日，城破之时，其屹立城头，随之没入黄沙。玉门城建成后，曾为其立像纪念。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名重装干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: Artisan's Shadow
relics.effect: Each time the leftmost Operator in the deployment area is deployed, all Operators on the field gain SP equal to 100% of the DP spent
relics.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a master craftsman who pursued perfection in their craft all their life. Villains coveted that skill, but the artisan was swayed by neither money nor torture, wishing only that the craft remain unsullied. They died in a bandits' den, and their writings were burned, never passed on.
relics.unlock: Complete a battle while having at least 3 Supporter Operators

zh.name: 匠影
zh.effect: 每次部署待部署区最左侧的干员时，使全场干员获得消耗费用100%的技力
zh.flavor: 为纪念一位巧手者而制的皮影。其一生追求技艺之极致。歹人垂涎其技，而其不为金钱所惑，亦不为皮肉苦所动，只望其技不染。后殁于贼穴，其著作亦付之一炬，未传后人。
zh.unlock: 携带不小于3名辅助干员完成一场战斗

relics.name: Performer's Shadow
relics.effect: On entering battle, the leftmost Operator in the deployment area gains +10 Starting SP, +30 ASPD, and +30% ATK
relics.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a legendary dancer. Legend says that dancing by the great river, she conjured the might of towering waves; dancing in the woods, the beauty of spring buds. She lived for dance, retired after an injury in old age, and soon passed away. Countless dancers have copied her poses without capturing their spirit, to everyone's regret.

zh.name: 艺影
zh.effect: 进入战斗时，待部署区最左侧的干员初始技力+10，攻击速度+30，攻击力+30%
zh.flavor: 为纪念一位传奇舞者而制的皮影。传闻其舞于大江，舞出巨浪之势；舞于林间，舞出春芽之美。其一生为舞，年老后受伤隐退，不久便撒手人寰。无数舞者仿其姿而不得其意，可惜可叹。

relics.name: Merchant's Shadow
relics.effect: On entering battle, the rightmost Operator in the deployment area gains +2 Block, +50% DEF, and +50% Max HP, and refunds 50% of their DP Cost after deployment
relics.flavor: A shadow puppet made in memory of a wealthy, shrewd merchant who once gathered a civilian caravan to cross catastrophe-prone lands, trading between city and countryside to ease shortages. Just as the highway between the cities was finally completed, he died in an accident.

zh.name: 商影
zh.effect: 进入战斗时，待部署区最右侧的干员阻挡数+2，防御力+50%，最大生命值+50%，部署后返回50%的部署费用
zh.flavor: 为纪念一位多财善贾之商人而制的皮影。其曾召集一支民间车队，穿梭于天灾高发地带，于城乡间买卖，缓物资之急。待城间驰道最终修成之时，却故于意外。

relics.name: Abyss-Edge Talisman
relics.effect: In the Garden, the first combat node entered on each floor drops an additional random Recruitment Voucher, and the number of Recruitment Vouchers you can keep +1
relics.flavor: Trusting you, the Sui Office approved your request to bring more Operators into the Garden. Still, when a stream fish enters unknown waters it must be very, very careful; they hope newcomers understand this.

zh.name: 临渊符
zh.effect: 界园中，每层进入的首个战斗节点额外掉落一张随机招募券，可留存的招募券数量+1
zh.flavor: 出于对你的信任，司岁台通过了你携带更多干员入园的申请。只不过，溪鳞入陌河，需慎之又慎，这个道理他们希望新来者明白。

relics.name: Three-Legged Golden Chick
relics.effect: On obtaining, randomly double one of the following resources you hold: Originium Ingots, Hope, or Objective Shield
relics.flavor: An auspicious creature with unusual feet. They say its three legs stand for rise and fall, life and death, flourishing and ruin; whichever foot lands on a person first, they will be blessed in that respect forever. According to the Sui Office's research, the creature has the look and habits of a feathered beast, but perhaps...

zh.name: 三足金雏
zh.effect: 获得时随机使持有的以下资源之一翻倍：源石锭、希望、护盾
zh.flavor: 异足的祥瑞，听说三只脚分别对应盛衰、生死、兴亡，哪一只脚先落在人身上，其人便可在那方面永享福泽。据司岁台的研究，这生物虽有羽兽的样貌和习性，但恐怕......

relics.name: Raidian's Handheld Console
relics.effect: For each Summon on the field, all [Summons] gain +100 ATK and +100 DEF (stacks up to 10 times)
relics.flavor: Packed with lovingly made minigames. The game protagonists always carry traces of the devices Raidian operates every day, but never Raidian herself.

zh.name: 电弧的掌机
zh.effect: 场上每存在一名召唤物，使全体【召唤物】的攻击力+100，防御力+100（最高叠加10层）
zh.flavor: 塞入了许多精心制作的小游戏，在游戏主角的身上总能看到电弧日常操控的器械的影子，偏偏没有她自己。

relics.name: Heartbound Listening Bell
relics.effect: Each time an Operator becomes a Candle Attendant through an operation, all [Candle Attendants] gain +40% ATK, gain 4 DP after deployment, and have -4% Redeployment Time (up to 4 stacks)
relics.flavor: After the inauguration ceremony, a new Candlebearer goes to meet those who came before: knotted eave bells hanging in the office, ring linked to ring, each in different colors and techniques. Having listened to their clear chimes, the Candlebearer weaves one new ring into the linked knots.

zh.name: 契心聆铃
zh.effect: 每当有干员通过作战成为伺烛客，所有【伺烛客】攻击力+40%，部署后获得4点部署费用，再部署时间-4%（最多4层）
zh.flavor: 新秉烛人在就任仪式后去面见各位前辈——悬在办公处的结绳檐铃，一环扣着一环，颜色手法各不相同——聆听那清越铃声后，秉烛人在那环环相扣的绳结上新编了一环。

relics.name: Zi-Hour Martial Sword
relics.effect: All Calamity nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; all allied Operators have -5% Redeployment Time, +1 stack for each Calamity node completed (up to 6 stacks)
relics.flavor: An object condensed after the first double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a blade. Hone it through slaughter, and you will see its keen fury.

zh.name: 子武剑
zh.effect: 使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有祸乱节点变为可探索状态，我方所有干员再部署时间-5%，每完成一个祸乱节点叠加1层，最多6层
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第一个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为刀兵。以厮杀洗砺，便可见其锋锐的怒意。

relics.name: Wu-Hour Merchant Shuttle
relics.effect: All Barter nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; goods in Barter nodes are discounted, and after buying all current goods in any shop, that shop's next refresh costs no Tickets
relics.flavor: An object condensed after the seventh double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a weaving shuttle. Weave it through communication, and you will see its layered sorrows.

zh.name: 午商梭
zh.effect: 使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有易与节点变为可探索状态，易与节点中的商品打折，且在任意商店中购买当前所有商品后，该商店下次刷新不消耗票券
zh.flavor: 岁兽残识第七个时辰入髓后凝聚的实物，形为织梭。以沟通编织，便可见其层叠的愁思。

relics.name: Shen-Hour Casting Wheel
relics.effect: Hope +1, Originium Ingots +3; all Everjoy nodes in the current or next Sui's Remnant Mind become explorable; has wondrous effects in some Everjoy nodes
relics.flavor: An object condensed after the ninth double-hour of Sui's Remnant Mind sank into the marrow, shaped like a bronze wheel. Forge it with curiosity, and you will see its free-spirited openness.

zh.name: 申铸轮
zh.effect: 希望+1，源石锭+3，使当前或下次进入的岁兽残识中所有常乐节点变为可探索状态，在部分常乐节点中有奇妙的作用
